1207:
1208:/*
1209: * compositor_resize_window - resize a window's LOGICAL surface (GFX-DYN-01).
1210: *
1211: * Reallocates the window pixel buffer to w x h, reflows the embedded terminal
1212: * to the new cell grid, and resets the on-screen draw size to match (crisp,
1213: * non-scaled).  Allocation happens here, so this must be called from process
1214: * context (it backs SYS_WINDOW_RESIZE), never from an IRQ.  Returns 0 on
1215: * success, -1 on failure (the old surface is kept on failure).
1216: */
1217:
1218:/*
1219: * gfx_notify_client - deliver one compositor event to a client, and ACCOUNT for
1220: * the loss when it cannot be delivered.
1221: *
1222: * Every caller below runs in IRQ or near-IRQ context with no one to return a
1223: * failure to, and each used to drop the result.  That made "the window stopped
1224: * responding to the mouse" and "the app kept drawing at the old size"
1225: * unattributable: the event simply never arrived and nothing recorded it.
1226: *
1227: * Logging per event is not an option -- a full queue would become an interrupt
1228: * storm -- so losses are COUNTED and only the ONSET is announced.  One place
1229: * owns the policy so the call sites cannot drift apart, which is the same
1230: * reason OS1_report_error is a single seam in userland.
1231: */
1232:unsigned long gfx_dropped_events;
1233:static void gfx_notify_client(int pid, struct ipc_message *m,
1234:                              const char *what) {
1235:  if (pid <= 0)
1236:    return;
1237:  if (kernel_ipc_send(pid, m) != 0) {
1238:    if (gfx_dropped_events++ == 0)
1239:      pr_err("compositor: %s to pid %d was DROPPED (receiver gone or queue "
1240:             "full); further losses are counted in gfx_dropped_events\n",
1241:             what, pid);
1242:  }
1243:}
1244:
1245:int compositor_resize_window(int window_id, int w, int h) {
1246:  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 4096 || h > 4096)
1247:    return -1;
1248:
1249:  uint64_t flags;
1250:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1251:  struct window *win = NULL;
1252:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1253:    if (windows[i].id == window_id) {
1254:      win = &windows[i];
1255:      break;
1256:    }
1257:  }
1258:  if (!win) {
1259:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1260:    return -1;
1261:  }
1262:
1263:  /* No-op if already at this logical size: keeps the grip-resize release path
1264:   * (which echoes an INPUT_TYPE_RESIZE) from looping when the app re-applies
1265:   * the same size. */
1266:  if (win->width == w && win->height == h && win->draw_w == w &&
1267:      win->draw_h == h) {
1268:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1269:    return 0;
1270:  }
1271:
1272:  /* Allocate the new surface before touching the live one. */
1273:  uint32_t *nbuf = (uint32_t *)kmalloc((size_t)w * h * 4);
1274:  if (!nbuf) {
1275:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1276:    return -1;
1277:  }
1278:  for (int p = 0; p < w * h; p++)
1279:    nbuf[p] = win->bg_color;
1280:
1281:  /* Damage the OLD on-screen footprint so the vacated area is repainted. */
1282:  int old_dw = win->draw_w > 0 ? win->draw_w : win->width;
1283:  int old_dh = win->draw_h > 0 ? win->draw_h : win->height;
1284:  expand_damage(win->x, win->y - compositor_titlebar_height(), old_dw,
1285:                old_dh + compositor_titlebar_height());
1286:
1287:  uint32_t *obuf = win->buffer;
1288:  win->buffer = nbuf;
1289:  win->width = w;
1290:  win->height = h;
1291:  win->draw_w = w; /* crisp: on-screen == new logical */
1292:  win->draw_h = h;
1293:  win->has_alpha = ((win->bg_color >> 24) != 0xFF);
1294:
1295:  /* Reflow the terminal to the new cell grid. */
1296:  int char_w = graphics_font_max_width();
1297:  int char_h = graphics_font_height();
1298:  if (char_w > 0 && char_h > 0 &&
1299:      term_resize(&win->term, w / char_w, h / char_h) != 0)
1300:    pr_err("compositor: terminal reflow to %dx%d cells failed for pid %d — the "
1301:           "window keeps the OLD cell grid and will render clipped\n",
1302:           w / char_w, h / char_h, win->pid);
1303:
1304:  /* Damage the NEW footprint and repaint. */
1305:  expand_damage(win->x, win->y - compositor_titlebar_height(), w,
1306:                h + compositor_titlebar_height());
1307:  compositor_dirty = 1;
1308:  int owner = win->pid;
1309:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1310:
1311:  if (obuf)
1312:    kfree(obuf);
1313:
1314:  /* Notify the owner of its new logical size (outside the lock: kernel_ipc_send
1315:   * takes sched_lock — never nest it under compositor_lock, cf. GFX-COMP-03).
1316:   */
1317:  if (owner > 0) {
1318:    struct ipc_message msg = {0};
1319:    msg.type = IPC_TYPE_RESIZE;
1320:    msg.data1 = (uint64_t)w;
1321:    msg.data2 = (uint64_t)h;
1322:    /* GFX-DYN-01: this message IS how a client learns its new logical size.
1323:     * Dropping it leaves the app drawing at the old dimensions against a
1324:     * surface that already changed -- visible as clipped or stretched output
1325:     * with nothing in the log to connect it to the resize. */
1326:    if (kernel_ipc_send(owner, &msg) != 0)
1327:      pr_err("compositor: resize notify to pid %d failed — it will keep "
1328:             "drawing at its previous size\n",
1329:             owner);
1330:  }
1331:  return 0;
1332:}
1333:
1334:/*
1335: * The VT/ANSI terminal emulator (blend_pixel, SGR, CSI, caret, scroll) was
1336: * extracted to kernel/graphics/term.c (GFX-DYN-01, #123).  Pixel blending now
1337: * uses gl_blend_pixel() from <graphics/gl.h>.
1338: */
1339:
1340:/* Erase carets on every window not owned by keep_pid; marks damage so they
1341: * repaint.  Caller holds compositor_lock.  Used on focus changes so the caret
1342: * follows the input window instead of lingering on the one that lost focus. */
1343:static void __clear_other_carets_locked(int keep_pid) {
1344:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1345:    struct window *win = &windows[i];
1346:    if (win->id == 0 || !win->term.caret_shown || win->pid == keep_pid)
1347:      continue;
1348:    struct gl_surface s = {.width = win->width,
1349:                           .height = win->height,
1350:                           .stride = win->width,
1351:                           .buffer = win->buffer,
1352:                           .capacity = (size_t)win->width * win->height};
1353:    gfx_surface_verify(&s, "__clear_other_carets_locked/win");
1354:    term_clear_caret(&win->term, &s);
1355:    win->term.focused = 0;
1356:    expand_damage(win->x, win->y - compositor_titlebar_height(), win->width,
1357:                  win->height + compositor_titlebar_height());
1358:    compositor_dirty = 1;
1359:  }
1360:}
1361:
1362:/* compositor_focus_changed - public hook for SYS_SET_FOCUS: wipe the caret off
1363: * windows that just lost keyboard focus. */
1364:void compositor_focus_changed(int new_pid) {
1365:  uint64_t flags;
1366:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1367:  __clear_other_carets_locked(new_pid);
1368:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1369:}
1370:
1371:/*
1372: * Write text to a window's terminal emulator.  Thin compositor seam over the
1373: * extracted VT engine (term.c, #123): look up the window, hand the terminal the
1374: * window's content surface, mark damage.  ANSI parsing, caret, scroll and SGR
1375: * all live in term_write().
1376: */
1377:void compositor_window_write(int win_id, const char *buf, size_t count) {
1378:  uint64_t flags;
1379:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1380:  struct window *win = NULL;
1381:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1382:    if (windows[i].id == win_id) {
1383:      win = &windows[i];
1384:      break;
1385:    }
1386:  }
1387:  if (win == NULL || win->buffer == NULL) {
1388:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1389:    return;
1390:  }
1391:
1392:  struct gl_surface win_surf = {.width = win->width,
1393:                                .height = win->height,
1394:                                .stride = win->width,
1395:                                .buffer = win->buffer,
1396:                                .capacity = (size_t)win->width * win->height};
1397:  gfx_surface_verify(&win_surf, "compositor_window_write/win");
1398:
1399:  /* The caret is drawn only on the window that currently owns keyboard input.
1400:   */
1401:  win->term.focused = (win->pid == keyboard_focus_pid);
1402:  term_write(&win->term, &win_surf, buf, count);
1403:
1404:  /* Mark compositor as needing redraw (window area including title bar) */
1405:  expand_damage(win->x, win->y - compositor_titlebar_height(), win->width,
1406:                win->height + compositor_titlebar_height());
1407:  compositor_dirty = 1;
1408:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1409:}
1410:
1411:/*
1412: * Draw simple mouse cursor
1413: */
1414:
1415:/*
1416: * Handle Mouse Click
1417: */
1418:void compositor_handle_click(int button, int state) {
1419:  if (state == 0) {
1420:    /* Button up: end drag/resize.  If we were resizing, tell the window owner
1421:     * its new size so it can reallocate a crisp buffer (it may ignore it and
1422:     * stay scaled). */
1423:    int notify_pid = -1, nw = 0, nh = 0;
1424:    int release_pid = -1;
1425:    struct ipc_message release_msg = {0};
1426:    uint64_t rflags;
1427:    spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &rflags);
1428:    /* Only the LEFT button drives drag/resize, so only its release ends
1429:     * them (a right/middle release must not cancel an ongoing left-drag). */
1430:    if (button == BTN_LEFT) {
1431:      dragging_window_id = -1;
1432:      if (resizing_window_id != -1) {
1433:        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1434:          if (windows[i].id == resizing_window_id) {
1435:            notify_pid = windows[i].pid;
1436:            nw = windows[i].draw_w;
1437:            nh = windows[i].draw_h;
1438:            break;
1439:          }
1440:        }
1441:        resizing_window_id = -1;
1442:        resize_edge = 0;
1443:      }
1444:    }
1445:    /* Deliver the RELEASE to the focused app with the same IPC_TYPE_MOUSE
1446:     * message the press uses (data2 = 0) — no new ABI.  Button-state
1447:     * consumers (SDL tracks pressed buttons) need the matching release or
1448:     * every press after the first is treated as still-held.  The pointer may
1449:     * be released outside the window, so coordinates are clamped into the
1450:     * content area before the draw-rect -> logical mapping. */
1451:    if (keyboard_focus_pid > 0) {
1452:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1453:        struct window *fw = &windows[i];
1454:        if (fw->id == 0 || !fw->visible || fw->passive ||
1455:            fw->pid != keyboard_focus_pid)
1456:          continue;
1457:        int fdw = fw->draw_w > 0 ? fw->draw_w : fw->width;
1458:        int fdh = fw->draw_h > 0 ? fw->draw_h : fw->height;
1459:        int rel_x = mouse_x - fw->x;
1460:        int rel_y = mouse_y - fw->y;
1461:        if (rel_x < 0)
1462:          rel_x = 0;
1463:        if (rel_y < 0)
1464:          rel_y = 0;
1465:        if (rel_x >= fdw)
1466:          rel_x = fdw - 1;
1467:        if (rel_y >= fdh)
1468:          rel_y = fdh - 1;
1469:        if (fdw > 0 && fdw != fw->width)
1470:          rel_x = (int)((int64_t)rel_x * fw->width / fdw);
1471:        if (fdh > 0 && fdh != fw->height)
1472:          rel_y = (int)((int64_t)rel_y * fw->height / fdh);
1473:        release_msg.from = 0; /* Kernel */
1474:        release_msg.type = IPC_TYPE_MOUSE;
1475:        release_msg.data1 = (uint64_t)button;
1476:        release_msg.data2 = 0;
1477:        memcpy(release_msg.payload, &rel_x, 4);
1478:        memcpy(release_msg.payload + 4, &rel_y, 4);
1479:        release_pid = keyboard_focus_pid;
1480:        break;
1481:      }
1482:    }
1483:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, rflags);
1484:    if (notify_pid > 0) {
1485:      struct ipc_message msg = {0};
1486:      msg.type = IPC_TYPE_RESIZE;
1487:      msg.data1 = (uint64_t)nw;
1488:      msg.data2 = (uint64_t)nh;
1489:      /* Same contract as above: a lost resize is a client stuck at the wrong
1490:       * size, not a cosmetic miss. */
1491:      if (kernel_ipc_send(notify_pid, &msg) != 0)
1492:        pr_err("compositor: resize notify to pid %d failed — it will keep "
1493:               "drawing at its previous size\n",
1494:               notify_pid);
1495:    }
1496:    if (release_pid > 0 && kernel_ipc_send(release_pid, &release_msg) != 0)
1497:      pr_err("compositor: release notify to pid %d failed — it may believe it "
1498:             "still holds the pointer grab\n",
1499:             release_pid);
1500:    return;
1501:  }
1502:
1503:  if (state != 1)
1504:    return;
1505:
1506:  uint64_t flags;
1507:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1508:
1509:  struct window *hit = NULL;
1510:  int max_z = -1;
1511:
1512:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1513:    /* Passive windows (system notifications) are click-through: never
1514:     * hit-tested, so a click on the popup passes to whatever is beneath it and
1515:     * the popup neither steals focus/caret nor receives an IPC_TYPE_MOUSE
1516:     * event. */
1517:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].visible && !windows[i].passive) {
1518:      int dw = windows[i].draw_w > 0 ? windows[i].draw_w : windows[i].width;
1519:      int dh = windows[i].draw_h > 0 ? windows[i].draw_h : windows[i].height;
1520:      int title_top = windows[i].y - compositor_titlebar_height();
1521:      if (mouse_x >= windows[i].x && mouse_x < windows[i].x + dw &&
1522:          mouse_y >= title_top && mouse_y < windows[i].y + dh) {
1523:        if (windows[i].z_order > max_z) {
1524:          max_z = windows[i].z_order;
1525:          hit = &windows[i];
1526:        }
1527:      }
1528:    }
1529:  }
1530:
1531:  if (!hit) {
1532:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1533:    return;
1534:  }
1535:
1536:  /* Bring to front */
1537:  int top_z = 0;
1538:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1539:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].z_order > top_z)
1540:      top_z = windows[i].z_order;
1541:  }
1542:  hit->z_order = top_z + 1;
1543:
1544:  /* Update keyboard focus to this process — push the hint down (#67). */
1545:  if (keyboard_focus_pid != hit->pid) {
1546:    pr_info("Compositor: Focus changed to PID %d (Window '%s')\n", hit->pid,
1547:            hit->title);
1548:    sched_set_focus_pid(hit->pid);
1549:  }
1550:
1551:  /* Interactive resize (F1): a press within RESIZE_GRIP of the
1552:   * left/right/bottom edge starts an edge/corner resize.  The top edge stays
1553:   * drag-only (title bar).  Protected windows are not grip-resizable.  While
1554:   * resizing we change only draw_w/draw_h (compositor scales); the crisp
1555:   * realloc happens when the app handles the INPUT_TYPE_RESIZE sent on release.
1556:   */
1557:  {
1558:    int dw = hit->draw_w > 0 ? hit->draw_w : hit->width;
1559:    int dh = hit->draw_h > 0 ? hit->draw_h : hit->height;
1560:    int edge = 0;
1561:    if (mouse_y >= hit->y && mouse_y < hit->y + dh) {
1562:      if (mouse_x >= hit->x + dw - RESIZE_GRIP && mouse_x < hit->x + dw)
1563:        edge |= RESIZE_EDGE_R;
1564:      else if (mouse_x >= hit->x && mouse_x < hit->x + RESIZE_GRIP)
1565:        edge |= RESIZE_EDGE_L;
1566:    }
1567:    if (mouse_x >= hit->x && mouse_x < hit->x + dw &&
1568:        mouse_y >= hit->y + dh - RESIZE_GRIP && mouse_y < hit->y + dh)
1569:      edge |= RESIZE_EDGE_B;
1570:
1571:    /* FIX(GFX-COMP-RESIZE-01): top_most system chrome (nxbar, nxui's dock,
1572:     * nxntfy_srv's popup) must resize ONLY programmatically (bar_reinit/
1573:     * dock_reinit reacting to a screen-size change), never via an interactive
1574:     * mouse grip. `protected` alone did not cover this — it is set ONLY for
1575:     * PID 2 (the shell, compositor_create_window's hardcoded check) — so a
1576:     * click landing within RESIZE_GRIP of nxbar/nxui's edge (easy: nxbar spans
1577:     * the full screen width, its bottom edge sits exactly where users click
1578:     * things right below it) silently started an interactive resize, visibly
1579:     * distorting the bar/dock until its own next redraw() forced draw_w/draw_h
1580:     * back to its computed size — the "resizes momentarily then snaps back"
1581:     * bug. top_most already exists precisely to mark this class of window;
1582:     * reusing it here (rather than adding a second, parallel flag) needs no
1583:     * new state and no userland ABI change. */
1584:    if (button == BTN_LEFT && edge && !hit->protected && !hit->top_most) {
1585:      resizing_window_id = hit->id;
1586:      resize_edge = edge;
1587:      resize_start_mx = mouse_x;
1588:      resize_start_my = mouse_y;
1589:      resize_orig_w = dw;
1590:      resize_orig_h = dh;
1591:      resize_orig_x = hit->x;
1592:      expand_damage(0, 0, bb_width, bb_height);
1593:      compositor_dirty = 1;
1594:      spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1595:      return;
1596:    }
1597:  }
1598:
1599:  /*
1600:   * FIX(GFX-COMP-03): never call kernel_ipc_send() or process_terminate() while
1601:   * holding compositor_lock.  compositor_handle_click runs in mouse-IRQ
1602:   * context; kernel_ipc_send() takes sched_lock, and process_terminate() takes
1603:   * sched_lock then re-enters the compositor (compositor_destroy_windows_by_pid
1604:   * -> compositor_lock).  Holding compositor_lock across either is the reverse
1605:   * of process_terminate's own sched_lock->compositor_lock order — an SMP AB-BA
1606:   * deadlock against a concurrent kill on another CPU (the observed "freeze on
1607:   * window-close/kill").  So we capture the work into locals under the lock and
1608:   * perform it AFTER the single unlock below.
1609:   */
1610:
1611:  /* Capture the mouse event to deliver to the focused process. */
1612:  int send_pid = -1;
1613:  struct ipc_message msg = {0};
1614:  if (keyboard_focus_pid > 0) {
1615:    /* Relative coordinates, mapped from the on-screen draw rect back to the
1616:     * app's LOGICAL surface so the app sees its own coords.  Only presses in
1617:     * the CONTENT area are delivered: chrome presses (titlebar, buttons,
1618:     * drag) belong to the window manager, and a negative rel_y would leak
1619:     * WM geometry into the app's input stream. */
1620:    int hdw = hit->draw_w > 0 ? hit->draw_w : hit->width;
1621:    int hdh = hit->draw_h > 0 ? hit->draw_h : hit->height;
1622:    int rel_x = mouse_x - hit->x;
1623:    int rel_y = mouse_y - hit->y;
1624:    if (rel_x >= 0 && rel_y >= 0 && rel_x < hdw && rel_y < hdh) {
1625:      if (hdw > 0 && hdw != hit->width)
1626:        rel_x = (int)((int64_t)rel_x * hit->width / hdw);
1627:      if (hdh > 0 && hdh != hit->height)
1628:        rel_y = (int)((int64_t)rel_y * hit->height / hdh);
1629:      msg.from = 0; /* Kernel */
1630:      msg.type = IPC_TYPE_MOUSE;
1631:      msg.data1 = (uint64_t)button;
1632:      msg.data2 = (uint64_t)state;
1633:      memcpy(msg.payload, &rel_x, 4);
1634:      memcpy(msg.payload + 4, &rel_y, 4);
1635:      send_pid = keyboard_focus_pid;
1636:    }
1637:  }
1638:
1639:  /* Capture a titlebar-button hit; the action is deferred until after unlock.
1640:   * Two buttons, right-aligned: [background][close].  The background button
1641:   * sits one button-width + BG_BUTTON_GAP to the LEFT of the close button. */
1642:  int do_close = 0;
1643:  int close_pid = 0;
1644:  int do_minimize = 0;
1645:  int min_id = 0;
1646:  if (button == BTN_LEFT && !hit->protected) {
1647:    const compositor_style_t *st = compositor_style_active();
1648:    int hdw = hit->draw_w > 0 ? hit->draw_w : hit->width;
1649:    int title_h = compositor_titlebar_height();
1650:    int decor_y = hit->y - title_h;
1651:
1652:    /* Same gfx_chrome geometry the render pass paints with — the hit-test
1653:     * can no longer drift from the pixels on screen. */
1654:    gfx_button_geometry_t buttons;
1655:    gfx_chrome_button_geometry(hit->x, hdw, decor_y, title_h, st->button_shape,
1656:                               st->button_side, &buttons);
1657:    int hit_button = gfx_chrome_button_hit(&buttons, mouse_x, mouse_y);
1658:    if (hit_button == GFX_BUTTON_CLOSE) {
1659:      do_close = 1;
1660:      close_pid = hit->pid;
1661:    } else if (hit_button == GFX_BUTTON_BACKGROUND) {
1662:      do_minimize = 1;
1663:      min_id = hit->id;
1664:    }
1665:  }
1666:
1667:  /* Check for drag start (skipped when closing/minimizing, matching the old
1668:   * early-return).  Left button only: right/middle never start a drag. */
1669:  if (button == BTN_LEFT && !do_close && !do_minimize &&
1670:      mouse_y >= hit->y - compositor_titlebar_height() && mouse_y < hit->y) {
1671:    dragging_window_id = hit->id;
1672:    drag_off_x = mouse_x - hit->x;
1673:    drag_off_y = mouse_y - hit->y;
1674:  }
1675:
1676:  expand_damage(0, 0, bb_width, bb_height);
1677:  compositor_dirty = 1;
1678:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1679:
1680:  /*
1681:   * Cross-subsystem calls, now strictly OUTSIDE compositor_lock
1682:   * (FIX(GFX-COMP-03)). Both validate their target pid internally, so a
1683:   * window/process that changed between the unlock and here is handled
1684:   * gracefully. Input delivery uses the same kernel_ipc_send transport the
1685:   * keyboard driver uses. Window close goes through the process-layer intent
1686:   * seam window_request_close() (#69) — the compositor no longer references
1687:   * process_terminate, so graphics does not drive process lifecycle directly.
1688:   * NOTE: the close still force-terminates in mouse-IRQ context; deferring it
1689:   * to a safe context is the separate SCHED-03 follow-up, now localised behind
1690:   * the seam. */
1691:  gfx_notify_client(send_pid, &msg, "click event");
1692:  if (do_close) {
1693:    pr_info("Compositor: Close button -> request close of PID %d\n", close_pid);
1694:    /* Window-close INTENT seam (#69, docs/PROCESS-KILL-MODEL.md): the kernel's
1695:     * window-aware subtree kill takes the window owner and its WINDOWLESS
1696:     * children (nxexec's hosted terminal program), sparing windowed children.
1697:     * The actual page/stack free is deferred to the scheduler reaper, so the
1698:     * IRQ-context call here only marks the subtree — the heavy compositor
1699:     * render that used to smash a stack from this context is now in userspace
1700:     * (SCHED-STACK-ISO), so the IRQ path is shallow. */
1701:    window_request_close(close_pid);
1702:  }
1703:  /* Background button: send the window to the dock.  compositor_minimize_window
1704:   * re-takes compositor_lock, so it must run here (after the unlock), and it
1705:   * re-finds the window by id, so a slot that changed meanwhile is handled
1706:   * gracefully — same contract as window_request_close above. */
1707:  if (do_minimize && compositor_minimize_window(min_id) != 0)
1708:    pr_err("compositor: minimize of window %d failed — the user clicked the "
1709:           "dock button and nothing happened\n",
1710:           min_id);
1711:}
1712:
1713:/*
1714: * Update Mouse Position
1715: */
1716:
1717:void compositor_update_mouse(int dx, int dy, int absolute) {
1718:  /* The cursor lives in desktop-virtual space (the backbuffer), which equals
1719:   * the physical scanout at zoom 100 but differs under HiDPI/zoom (F2). */
1720:  int width = bb_width > 0 ? bb_width : 800;
1721:  int height = bb_height > 0 ? bb_height : 600;
1722:
1723:  /* S1b: hold compositor_lock for the whole window-list update.  This handler
1724:   * runs in mouse-IRQ context and was the ONLY window-list mutator WITHOUT the
1725:   * lock — racing window create/destroy (e.g. 'stress' churning windows) and
1726:   * the render tick.  The torn drag/resize writes to windows[].draw_w/draw_h
1727:   * could then be consumed out-of-bounds by a concurrent draw syscall
1728:   * (observed: kernel stack/pointer smash, RIP->0xf9, while dragging a demo3d
1729:   * window). Same lock order as compositor_handle_click (no caller holds it;
1730:   * the helpers called below — expand_damage, compositor_titlebar_height — take
1731:   * no lock). */
1732:  uint64_t cflags;
1733:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &cflags);
1734:
1735:  int old_mx = mouse_x, old_my = mouse_y;
1736:
1737:  if (absolute) {
1738:    /* Absolute pointer: events carry one axis at a time, so a negative
1739:     * component means "leave this axis unchanged". Values are normalized to [0,
1740:     * INPUT_ABS_MAX]; scale to framebuffer pixels. This is what makes the
1741:     * cursor track 1:1 under absolute hosts like UTM (DRV-INPUT-01 #125),
1742:     * instead of a relative device saturating at a screen edge. */
1743:    if (dx >= 0)
1744:      mouse_x = (int)(((long)dx * (width - 1)) / INPUT_ABS_MAX);
1745:    if (dy >= 0)
1746:      mouse_y = (int)(((long)dy * (height - 1)) / INPUT_ABS_MAX);
1747:  } else {
1748:    mouse_x += dx;
1749:    mouse_y += dy;
1750:  }
1751:
1752:  /* Clamp to screen */
1753:  if (mouse_x < 0)
1754:    mouse_x = 0;
1755:  if (mouse_x >= width)
1756:    mouse_x = width - 1;
1757:  if (mouse_y < 0)
1758:    mouse_y = 0;
1759:  if (mouse_y >= height)
1760:    mouse_y = height - 1;
1761:
1762:  /* Handle Dragging */
1763:  if (dragging_window_id != -1) {
1764:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1765:      if (windows[i].id == dragging_window_id) {
1766:        int dw = windows[i].draw_w > 0 ? windows[i].draw_w : windows[i].width;
1767:        int dh = windows[i].draw_h > 0 ? windows[i].draw_h : windows[i].height;
1768:        windows[i].x = mouse_x - drag_off_x;
1769:        windows[i].y = mouse_y - drag_off_y;
1770:        /* Enforce screen boundaries (use on-screen draw size).
1771:         * FIX(GFX-COMP-RESERVE-01): clamp against the live nxbar/nxui
1772:         * reservation instead of just compositor_titlebar_height() at the
1773:         * top and the bare screen edge at the bottom — a dragged window used
1774:         * to be draggable right underneath nxbar, or down behind the dock. */
1775:        if (windows[i].x < 0)
1776:          windows[i].x = 0;
1777:        if (windows[i].x + dw > width)
1778:          windows[i].x = width - dw;
1779:        int reserved_top = compositor_reserved_top_locked(windows[i].id);
1780:        int reserved_bottom = compositor_reserved_bottom_locked(windows[i].id);
1781:        if (windows[i].y < reserved_top)
1782:          windows[i].y = reserved_top;
1783:        if (windows[i].y + dh > height - reserved_bottom)
1784:          windows[i].y = height - reserved_bottom - dh;
1785:        break;
1786:      }
1787:    }
1788:  }
1789:
1790:  /* Handle interactive resize (F1): adjust the on-screen draw size from the
1791:   * mouse delta + grabbed edge; the compositor scales the logical surface. */
1792:  if (resizing_window_id != -1) {
1793:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1794:      if (windows[i].id != resizing_window_id)
1795:        continue;
1796:      int ddx = mouse_x - resize_start_mx;
1797:      int ddy = mouse_y - resize_start_my;
1798:      int nw = resize_orig_w, nh = resize_orig_h, nx = resize_orig_x;
1799:      if (resize_edge & RESIZE_EDGE_R)
1800:        nw = resize_orig_w + ddx;
1801:      if (resize_edge & RESIZE_EDGE_L) {
1802:        nw = resize_orig_w - ddx;
1803:        nx = resize_orig_x + ddx;
1804:      }
1805:      if (resize_edge & RESIZE_EDGE_B)
1806:        nh = resize_orig_h + ddy;
1807:      if (nw < RESIZE_MIN_W) {
1808:        if (resize_edge &
1809:            RESIZE_EDGE_L) /* keep right edge fixed when clamping */
1810:          nx = resize_orig_x + (resize_orig_w - RESIZE_MIN_W);
1811:        nw = RESIZE_MIN_W;
1812:      }
1813:      if (nh < RESIZE_MIN_H)
1814:        nh = RESIZE_MIN_H;
1815:      /* S1b: clamp the on-screen size to the screen so a runaway resize cannot
1816:       * push draw_w/draw_h past the backbuffer (OOB in the scaling blit). */
1817:      if (nw > width)
1818:        nw = width;
1819:      if (nh > height)
1820:        nh = height;
1821:      windows[i].draw_w = nw;
1822:      windows[i].draw_h = nh;
1823:      windows[i].x = nx < 0 ? 0 : nx;
1824:      break;
1825:    }
1826:  }
1827:
1828:  /* Mark compositor as needing redraw - don't render from IRQ! */
1829:  if (dragging_window_id != -1 || resizing_window_id != -1) {
1830:    expand_damage(0, 0, bb_width, bb_height);
1831:  } else {
1832:    /* Only the old and new cursor areas (12x16 + 1px border) */
1833:    expand_damage(old_mx - 1, old_my - 1, 14, 18);
1834:    expand_damage(mouse_x - 1, mouse_y - 1, 14, 18);
1835:  }
1836:  compositor_dirty = 1;
1837:
1838:  /* Capture a motion event for the focused window using the SAME
1839:   * IPC_TYPE_MOUSE message the click path sends — no new ABI.  button = 0
1840:   * means "no button, motion only": every existing consumer already treats a
1841:   * zero button as not-a-click, and the SDL2 adapter turns it into
1842:   * SDL_MOUSEMOTION.  Rate-limited so the unbounded per-process IPC queue
1843:   * cannot be flooded from mouse-IRQ context; delivery happens after the
1844:   * unlock, mirroring compositor_handle_click.  Suppressed during drag/resize
1845:   * (the window itself is moving under the cursor). */
1846:  int motion_pid = -1;
1847:  struct ipc_message motion_msg = {0};
1848:  if ((mouse_x != old_mx || mouse_y != old_my) && keyboard_focus_pid > 0 &&
1849:      dragging_window_id == -1 && resizing_window_id == -1) {
1850:    static uint64_t last_motion_ns;
1851:    uint64_t now = mono_ns();
1852:    if (now - last_motion_ns >= 8000000ull) { /* >= 8 ms (~125 Hz) */
1853:      for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1854:        struct window *fw = &windows[i];
1855:        if (fw->id == 0 || !fw->visible || fw->passive ||
1856:            fw->pid != keyboard_focus_pid)
1857:          continue;
1858:        int fdw = fw->draw_w > 0 ? fw->draw_w : fw->width;
1859:        int fdh = fw->draw_h > 0 ? fw->draw_h : fw->height;
1860:        int rel_x = mouse_x - fw->x;
1861:        int rel_y = mouse_y - fw->y;
1862:        if (rel_x < 0 || rel_y < 0 || rel_x >= fdw || rel_y >= fdh)
1863:          break; /* cursor outside the focused content area: no motion */
1864:        /* Map from the on-screen draw rect back to LOGICAL surface coords,
1865:         * exactly like the click path. */
1866:        if (fdw > 0 && fdw != fw->width)
1867:          rel_x = (int)((int64_t)rel_x * fw->width / fdw);
1868:        if (fdh > 0 && fdh != fw->height)
1869:          rel_y = (int)((int64_t)rel_y * fw->height / fdh);
1870:        motion_msg.from = 0; /* Kernel */
1871:        motion_msg.type = IPC_TYPE_MOUSE;
1872:        motion_msg.data1 = 0; /* no button: motion only */
1873:        motion_msg.data2 = 0;
1874:        memcpy(motion_msg.payload, &rel_x, 4);
1875:        memcpy(motion_msg.payload + 4, &rel_y, 4);
1876:        motion_pid = keyboard_focus_pid;
1877:        last_motion_ns = now;
1878:        break;
1879:      }
1880:    }
1881:  }
1882:
1883:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, cflags);
1884:
1885:  /* Outside compositor_lock (same contract as compositor_handle_click). */
1886:  gfx_notify_client(motion_pid, &motion_msg, "pointer motion");
1887:}
1888:
1889:/*
1890: * Composite All Windows to Screen
1891: */
1892:/*
1893: * Compositor Render (HAL + GL)
1894: */
1895:/*
1896: * Compositor Render (Region-based / Front-to-Back with Occlusion Culling)
1897: */
1898:#include <kernel/region.h>
1899:
1900:/* Rounded-rect membership (F3) now lives in gfx_chrome as
1901: * gfx_rrect_contains(), shared with the chrome shadow/border primitives. */
1902:
1903:static volatile int in_render = 0;
1904:static void compositor_render_internal(void) {
1905:  /* Atomic guard against concurrent rendering (multi-CPU or IRQ re-entrancy) */
1906:  if (__sync_lock_test_and_set(&in_render, 1))
1907:    return;
1908:
1909:  struct gpu_device *dev = gpu_get_primary();
1910:  if (!dev || !compositor_backbuffer) {
1911:    __sync_lock_release(&in_render);
1912:    return;
1913:  }
1914:
1915:  /* Use current buffer dimensions.  bb_pg snapshots the backing page count so
1916:   * the surface below carries its TRUE allocation (S-STAB): the whole raster
1917:   * path only clips against bb_w/bb_h, so if those ever exceeded the allocation
1918:   * (a geometry desync) every chrome/content write would run off the end into
1919:   * kernel RAM.  We hold compositor_lock here, so
1920:   * bb_width/height/pages/backbuffer are a consistent set. */
1921:  int bb_w = bb_width;
1922:  int bb_h = bb_height;
1923:  int bb_pg = bb_pages;
1924:  uint32_t *backbuffer = compositor_backbuffer;
1925:
1926:  /* Damage clip for this frame (perf §3.4): composite ONLY the changed region
1927:   * instead of the full scene.  Snapshot the accumulated damage (reset later at
1928:   * the flush) clamped to the screen.  The damage tracking is already complete
1929:   * — mouse-move damages the old+new cursor rects, drag/resize/window-ops
1930:   * full-damage — so this box always covers everything that changed.  The
1931:   * backbuffer persists between frames, so pixels outside the clip stay valid
1932:   * and are never re-touched (and the flush already uploads only this box).
1933:   * Cutting the per-frame composite to the damage box is the main fix for the
1934:   * "scattoso" jank: a cursor move now recomposites ~2 tiny rects, not
1935:   * 1280x800, and the render no longer stalls CPU0's timer IRQ for a full-scene
1936:   * pass. */
1937:  int clip_x1 = damage_x1 < 0 ? 0 : damage_x1;
1938:  int clip_y1 = damage_y1 < 0 ? 0 : damage_y1;
1939:  int clip_x2 = damage_x2 > bb_w ? bb_w : damage_x2;
1940:  int clip_y2 = damage_y2 > bb_h ? bb_h : damage_y2;
1941:  if (clip_x2 < clip_x1)
1942:    clip_x2 = clip_x1;
1943:  if (clip_y2 < clip_y1)
1944:    clip_y2 = clip_y1;
1945:  int clip_w = clip_x2 - clip_x1;
1946:  int clip_h = clip_y2 - clip_y1;
1947:
1948:  /* Active theme (colours) + style (form) + background — read once per frame.
1949:   */
1950:  const compositor_theme_t *th = compositor_theme_active();
1951:  const compositor_style_t *st = compositor_style_active();
1952:  const compositor_background_t *desk_bg = compositor_background_active();
1953:
1954:  /* Wrap backbuffer in GL Surface.  capacity = true backing size in pixels
1955:   * (S-STAB); gfx_surface_verify panics precisely if bb_w*bb_h ever outran the
1956:   * allocation instead of letting the chrome/content painters scribble kernel
1957:   * RAM (the UTM-panic class). */
1958:  compositor_bind_backbuffer_surface(bb_w, bb_h, bb_pg, backbuffer);
1959:  gfx_surface_verify(&compositor_frame_surface,
1960:                     "compositor_render_internal/backbuffer");
1961:  struct gl_surface *screen = &compositor_frame_surface;
1962:
1963:  /* Damage clip as the rect the gfx_chrome primitives honour. */
1964:  gfx_rect_t chrome_clip = {clip_x1, clip_y1, clip_w, clip_h};
1965:
1966:  /* Use static buffers to avoid stack pressure/smashing */
1967:  struct window **sorted = sorted_windows;
1968:  struct region **visible_regions = visible_regions_store;
1969:
1970:  memset(visible_regions, 0, sizeof(struct region *) * MAX_WINDOWS);
1971:
1972:  int count = 0;
1973:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS && count < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1974:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].visible) {
1975:      int dw = windows[i].draw_w > 0 ? windows[i].draw_w : windows[i].width;
1976:      int dh = windows[i].draw_h > 0 ? windows[i].draw_h : windows[i].height;
1977:      /* Skip off-screen (use on-screen draw size) */
1978:      if (windows[i].x >= bb_w || windows[i].y >= bb_h ||
1979:          windows[i].x + dw <= 0 || windows[i].y + dh <= 0)
1980:        continue;
1981:      sorted[count++] = &windows[i];
1982:    }
1983:  }
1984:
1985:  /* Bubble Sort */
1986:  for (int i = 0; i < count - 1; i++) {
1987:    for (int j = 0; j < count - i - 1; j++) {
1988:      if (sorted[j]->z_order > sorted[j + 1]->z_order) {
1989:        struct window *tmp = sorted[j];
1990:        sorted[j] = sorted[j + 1];
1991:        sorted[j + 1] = tmp;
1992:      }
1993:    }
1994:  }
1995:
1996:  /* Top Most handling */
1997:  /* Top Most handling: move all top-most windows to the end of the sorted list
1998:   */
1999:  int current_count = count;
2000:  for (int i = 0; i < current_count; i++) {
2001:    if (sorted[i]->top_most) {
2002:      struct window *tmp = sorted[i];
2003:      /* Shift remaining windows left */
2004:      for (int k = i; k < current_count - 1; k++) {
2005:        sorted[k] = sorted[k + 1];
2006:      }
2007:      sorted[current_count - 1] = tmp;
2008:      /* Decrement current_count so we don't re-process the window we just moved
2009:       */
2010:      current_count--;
2011:      /* Decrement i to process the window that was shifted into the current
2012:       * slot */
2013:      i--;
2014:    }
2015:  }
2016:
2017:  /*
2018:   * Two-Pass Rendering Algorithm
2019:   * Pass 1: Visibility Calculation (Top-Down)
2020:   * computes what part of each window is visible.
2021:   */
2022:  struct region *occluded = region_create();
2023:  if (!occluded) {
2024:    __sync_lock_release(&in_render);
2025:    return;
2026:  }
2027:
2028:  /* Iterate Top-to-Bottom for Occlusion */
2029:  for (int i = count - 1; i >= 0 && i < MAX_WINDOWS; i--) {
2030:    struct window *win = sorted[i];
2031:
2032:    /* On-screen draw size (== logical unless the surface is being scaled). */
2033:    int dw = win->draw_w > 0 ? win->draw_w : win->width;
2034:    int dh = win->draw_h > 0 ? win->draw_h : win->height;
2035:
2036:    /* Calculate Full Window Bounds (Content + Decorations) */
2037:    int win_y = win->top_most ? win->y : win->y - compositor_titlebar_height();
2038:    int win_h = win->top_most ? dh : dh + compositor_titlebar_height();
2039:
2040:    struct region *vis = region_create();
2041:    if (vis) {
2042:      region_add_rect(vis, win->x, win_y, dw, win_h);
2043:
2044:      /* Subtract currently occluded area */
2045:      for (int r = 0; r < occluded->count; r++) {
2046:        struct rect *or = &occluded->rects[r];
2047:        region_subtract(vis, or->x, or->y, or->w, or->h);
2048:      }
2049:
2050:      /* Clip to screen bounds */
2051:      region_intersect_rect(vis, 0, 0, bb_w, bb_h);
2052:      /* Clip to this frame's damage box (perf §3.4): only the changed area is
2053:       * recomposited; the rest of the backbuffer persists from last frame. */
2054:      region_intersect_rect(vis, clip_x1, clip_y1, clip_w, clip_h);
2055:    }
2056:
2057:    visible_regions[i] = vis;
2058:
2059:    /* Aggiungi a Occluded (Solo se la finestra non contiene trasparenze).
2060:     *
2061:     * FIX(GFX-COMP-CORNER-01): a rounded-corner window's occlusion footprint
2062:     * must NOT be the full bounding rect when st->rounded_corners is active —
2063:     * the 4 corner squares outside the rounded shape are not actually opaque
2064:     * (gfx_rrect_contains skips painting them; see the content/decoration
2065:     * paint loop below and gfx_chrome_border/shadow). Marking the FULL rect
2066:     * occluded blocked the layer underneath from ever being repainted at
2067:     * those exact corner pixels — and this window's own paint pass also never
2068:     * writes there (outside the rounded shape) — so the corner pixels simply
2069:     * kept whatever was left over from a previous frame: stale content,
2070:     * square (unrounded) leftovers, or garbage on a window's first frame at a
2071:     * new position/size. This is the "trasparenza/refresh/smussatura"
2072:     * compositor bug.
2073:     *
2074:     * Fix: occlude only the INSCRIBED rectangle set of the rounded rect (top
2075:     * strip + middle full-width strip + bottom strip, corners excluded) —
2076:     * a conservative SUBSET of the true opaque area (a rounded rect's corner
2077:     * quarter-circle sliver is technically opaque too, but treating it as
2078:     * "not occluded" only costs a few redundant corner-pixel repaints, never
2079:     * a correctness bug). The three strips are entirely within
2080:     * gfx_rrect_contains for radius rr, mirroring the same rr computation the
2081:     * paint loop below uses. */
2082:    if (!win->has_alpha) {
2083:      int rr = (st->rounded_corners && !win->top_most) ? st->border_radius : 0;
2084:      if (rr <= 0) {
2085:        region_add_rect(occluded, win->x, win_y, dw, win_h);
2086:      } else {
2087:        int cr = rr;
2088:        if (2 * cr > dw)
2089:          cr = dw / 2;
2090:        if (2 * cr > win_h)
2091:          cr = win_h / 2;
2092:        if (cr > 0) {
2093:          /* top strip (between the two top corners) */
2094:          region_add_rect(occluded, win->x + cr, win_y, dw - 2 * cr, cr);
2095:          /* middle strip (full width, corners above/below excluded) */
2096:          region_add_rect(occluded, win->x, win_y + cr, dw, win_h - 2 * cr);
2097:          /* bottom strip (between the two bottom corners) */
2098:          region_add_rect(occluded, win->x + cr, win_y + win_h - cr,
2099:                          dw - 2 * cr, cr);
2100:        } else {
2101:          region_add_rect(occluded, win->x, win_y, dw, win_h);
2102:        }
2103:      }
2104:    }
2105:  }
2106:
2107:  /* Calculate Background Region (Screen - Occluded) */
2108:  struct region *bg_region = region_create();
2109:  if (bg_region) {
2110:    region_add_rect(bg_region, 0, 0, bb_w, bb_h);
2111:    for (int r = 0; r < occluded->count; r++) {
2112:      struct rect *or = &occluded->rects[r];
2113:      region_subtract(bg_region, or->x, or->y, or->w, or->h);
2114:    }
2115:    /* Only repaint the background within this frame's damage box (perf §3.4).
2116:     */
2117:    region_intersect_rect(bg_region, clip_x1, clip_y1, clip_w, clip_h);
2118:
2119:    /* Draw Background — vertical gradient from the active background preset
2120:     * (desk_bg->bg_top -> desk_bg->bg_bottom), interpolated per row. */
2121:    uint32_t t_r = (desk_bg->bg_top >> 16) & 0xFF,
2122:             t_g = (desk_bg->bg_top >> 8) & 0xFF, t_b = desk_bg->bg_top & 0xFF;
2123:    uint32_t b_r = (desk_bg->bg_bottom >> 16) & 0xFF,
2124:             b_g = (desk_bg->bg_bottom >> 8) & 0xFF,
2125:             b_b = desk_bg->bg_bottom & 0xFF;
2126:    for (int r = 0; r < bg_region->count; r++) {
2127:      struct rect *bg = &bg_region->rects[r];
2128:      for (int y = 0; y < bg->h; y++) {
2129:        int sy = bg->y + y;
2130:        if (sy < 0 || sy >= bb_h)
2131:          continue;
2132:        /* Row colour: linear blend top->bottom by sy/bb_h. */
2133:        int denom = bb_h > 1 ? bb_h - 1 : 1;
2134:        uint32_t rr = t_r + (int)(b_r - t_r) * sy / denom;
2135:        uint32_t gg = t_g + (int)(b_g - t_g) * sy / denom;
2136:        uint32_t bb = t_b + (int)(b_b - t_b) * sy / denom;
2137:        uint32_t row_color = 0xFF000000 | (rr << 16) | (gg << 8) | bb;
2138:        for (int x = 0; x < bg->w; x++) {
2139:          int sx = bg->x + x;
2140:          if (sx >= 0 && sx < bb_w)
2141:            backbuffer[sy * bb_w + sx] = row_color;
2142:        }
2143:      }
2144:    }
2145:    region_destroy(bg_region);
2146:  }
2147:  region_destroy(occluded);
2148:  occluded = NULL; /* prevent double-free: cleanup at end of function also calls
2149:                      region_destroy(occluded) */
2150:
2151:  /* Pass 2: Rendering (Bottom-Up) - Painter's Algorithm with Clipping */
2152:  for (int i = 0; i < count && i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
2153:    struct window *win = sorted[i];
2154:    struct region *vis = visible_regions[i];
2155:
2156:    /* On-screen draw size + whether the logical surface needs scaling. */
2157:    int dw = win->draw_w > 0 ? win->draw_w : win->width;
2158:    int dh = win->draw_h > 0 ? win->draw_h : win->height;
2159:    int scaled = (dw != win->width || dh != win->height);
2160:
2161:    /* Skip windows entirely outside this frame's damage box (perf §3.4): their
2162:     * content (vis is already clipped to empty) AND chrome (title text / border
2163:     * / shadow drawn below) need not be repainted — that part of the backbuffer
2164:     * is unchanged.  Any leftover vis region is freed by the end-of-function
2165:     * cleanup loop, so the early continue does not leak. */
2166:    {
2167:      int wth = win->top_most ? 0 : compositor_titlebar_height();
2168:      int wy = win->y - wth;
2169:      int wfh = dh + wth;
2170:      /* Include the drop-shadow fringe in the footprint so a
2171:       * window whose body is just outside the damage box but whose shadow
2172:       * reaches into it is still reprocessed. */
2173:      int so = (st->shadows && !win->top_most) ? st->shadow_size : 0;
2174:      gfx_chrome_margins_t margins;
2175:      gfx_chrome_shadow_margins(st->shadow_type, so, &margins);
2176:      if (win->x - margins.left >= clip_x2 ||
2177:          win->x + dw + margins.right <= clip_x1 ||
2178:          wy - margins.top >= clip_y2 || wy + wfh + margins.bottom <= clip_y1)
2179:        continue;
2180:    }
2181:
2182:    /* Decoration Params */
2183:    int title_h = win->top_most ? 0 : compositor_titlebar_height();
2184:    int content_y = win->y;
2185:    int decor_y = win->y - title_h;
2186:
2187:    /* Style (F3): rounded corners + border applied to the full window rect
2188:     * (title + content); shadows drawn under the window.  top_most overlays
2189:     * (notifications, cursor layers) keep square, chrome-less. */
2190:    int full_h = title_h + dh;
2191:    int rr = (st->rounded_corners && !win->top_most) ? st->border_radius : 0;
2192:
2193:    /* Button geometry once per window (was recomputed per pixel). */
2194:    gfx_button_geometry_t buttons;
2195:    gfx_chrome_button_geometry(win->x, dw, decor_y, title_h, st->button_shape,
2196:                               st->button_side, &buttons);
2197:
2198:    /* Drop shadow: behaviour depends on st->shadow_type.
2199:     * Guard: shadows enabled, non-zero size, not a top-most overlay.
2200:     * Painters live in gfx_chrome and honour the frame's damage clip. */
2201:    if (st->shadows && st->shadow_size > 0 && !win->top_most) {
2202:      gfx_rect_t chrome_frame = {win->x, decor_y, dw, full_h};
2203:      if (st->shadow_type == 0)
2204:        gfx_chrome_shadow_solid(screen, &chrome_clip, &chrome_frame, rr,
2205:                                th->win_bg);
2206:      else if (st->shadow_type == 2)
2207:        gfx_chrome_shadow_premium(screen, &chrome_clip, &chrome_frame, rr,
2208:                                  st->shadow_size);
2209:      else if (st->shadow_type == 1)
2210:        gfx_chrome_shadow_fast(screen, &chrome_clip, &chrome_frame, rr,
2211:                               st->shadow_size);
2212:    }
2213:
2214:    if (vis) {
2215:      /* Iterate Visible Rects */
2216:      for (int r = 0; r < vis->count; r++) {
2217:        struct rect *vr = &vis->rects[r];
2218:
2219:        /* Draw pixels for this visible rect */
2220:        for (int dy = 0; dy < vr->h; dy++) {
2221:          for (int dx = 0; dx < vr->w; dx++) {
2222:            int screen_x = vr->x + dx;
2223:            int screen_y = vr->y + dy;
2224:            int screen_idx = screen_y * bb_w + screen_x;
2225:
2226:            /* Determine if we are in Decoration or Content */
2227:            if (screen_y < content_y) {
2228:              /* Decoration Area (Title Bar) */
2229:              if (screen_y >= decor_y) {
2230:                /* In Title Bar — macOS-style: la finestra a fuoco ha una
2231:                 * title bar piu' chiara, le altre restano piu' scure. */
2232:                uint32_t title_color = (win->pid == keyboard_focus_pid)
2233:                                           ? th->title_active
2234:                                           : th->title_inactive;
2235:
2236:                if (st->shadows && title_h > 0)
2237:                  title_color = gfx_chrome_titlebar_tint(st->shadow_type,
2238:                                                         screen_y - decor_y,
2239:                                                         title_h, title_color);
2240:
2241:                /* Titlebar buttons (gfx_chrome): geometry computed once per
2242:                 * window below; drawn only when the window is not protected —
2243:                 * consistent with compositor_handle_click ignoring the
2244:                 * buttons on hit->protected, which now shares the same
2245:                 * gfx_chrome_button_geometry. */
2246:                if (!win->protected)
2247:                  title_color = gfx_chrome_button_pixel(
2248:                      &buttons, st->button_shape, screen_x, screen_y,
2249:                      th->close_btn, COLOR_MIN_BTN,
2250:                      st->shadows && st->shadow_type == 2, title_color);
2251:
2252:                /* Round the top corners (F3). */
2253:                if (rr == 0 ||
2254:                    gfx_rrect_contains(screen_x - win->x, screen_y - decor_y,
2255:                                       dw, full_h, rr))
2256:                  backbuffer[screen_idx] = title_color;
2257:              }
2258:            } else {
2259:              /* Content Area.  Position within the on-screen draw rect... */
2260:              int draw_x = screen_x - win->x;
2261:              int draw_y = screen_y - win->y;
2262:
2263:              if (draw_x >= 0 && draw_x < dw && draw_y >= 0 && draw_y < dh &&
2264:                  (rr == 0 ||
2265:                   gfx_rrect_contains(screen_x - win->x, screen_y - decor_y, dw,
2266:                                      full_h, rr))) {
2267:                /* ...mapped back to the logical surface (nearest-sample scale
2268:                 * when draw size != logical size — GFX-DYN-01 surface model).
2269:                 */
2270:                int sx =
2271:                    scaled ? (int)((int64_t)draw_x * win->width / dw) : draw_x;
2272:                int sy =
2273:                    scaled ? (int)((int64_t)draw_y * win->height / dh) : draw_y;
2274:                if (sx < 0)
2275:                  sx = 0;
2276:                else if (sx >= win->width)
2277:                  sx = win->width - 1;
2278:                if (sy < 0)
2279:                  sy = 0;
2280:                else if (sy >= win->height)
2281:                  sy = win->height - 1;
2282:
2283:                if (win->buffer) {
2284:                  uint32_t pixel = win->buffer[sy * win->width + sx];
2285:                  backbuffer[screen_idx] =
2286:                      gl_blend_pixel(pixel, backbuffer[screen_idx]);
2287:                } else {
2288:                  backbuffer[screen_idx] =
2289:                      gl_blend_pixel(win->bg_color, backbuffer[screen_idx]);
2290:                }
2291:
2292:                /* Inner shadow / separator under titlebar (gfx_chrome) */
2293:                if (st->shadows && title_h > 0)
2294:                  backbuffer[screen_idx] = gfx_chrome_content_separator(
2295:                      st->shadow_type, draw_y, backbuffer[screen_idx]);
2296:              }
2297:            }
2298:          } // dx
2299:        } // dy
2300:      }
2301:      region_destroy(vis);
2302:      visible_regions[i] = NULL;
2303:    }
2304:
2305:    /* Draw Title Text - Naive Unclipped (Relies on Painter's Algo overwriting)
2306:     */
2307:    if (!win->top_most) {
2308:      int title_len = 0;
2309:      while (win->title[title_len] && title_len < 63)
2310:        title_len++;
2311:
2312:      int char_h = graphics_font_height();
2313:      int text_w = graphics_string_width(win->title);
2314:      int start_x = win->x + (dw - text_w) / 2;
2315:      int start_y =
2316:          decor_y + (20 - char_h) / 2; /* Center vertically in title bar */
2317:
2318:      /* macOS-style: il titolo della finestra a fuoco e' piu' luminoso,
2319:       * quello delle finestre inattive e' attenuato (systemGray). */
2320:      uint32_t text_color = (win->pid == keyboard_focus_pid)
2321:                                ? th->title_text_active
2322:                                : th->title_text_inactive;
2323:
2324:      /* Damage clip (GFX-COMP-03): title text is drawn unoccluded over the
2325:       * titlebar, so it must be confined to this frame's damage box or it would
2326:       * overpaint pixels outside the recomposited region. */
2327:      gl_draw_string_clipped(screen, start_x, start_y, win->title, text_color,
2328:                             clip_x1, clip_y1, clip_x2, clip_y2);
2329:    }
2330:
2331:    /* Window border (F3): 1px outline around the full window rect, following
2332:     * the rounded corners.  Drawn last so it sits on top of content + title. */
2333:    if (st->window_borders && !win->top_most) {
2334:      gfx_rect_t chrome_frame = {win->x, decor_y, dw, full_h};
2335:      gfx_chrome_border(screen, &chrome_clip, &chrome_frame, rr, th->border);
2336:    }
2337:  }
2338:
2339:  /* Cleanup any remaining regions in store */
2340:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
2341:    if (visible_regions_store[i]) {
2342:      region_destroy(visible_regions_store[i]);
2343:      visible_regions_store[i] = NULL;
2344:    }
2345:  }
2346:
2347:  /* Mouse Cursor (Always on top) */
2348:  static const char *cursor_bits[] = {
2349:      "X           ", "XX          ", "X.X         ", "X..X        ",
2350:      "X...X       ", "X....X      ", "X.....X     ", "X......X    ",
2351:      "X.......X   ", "X........X  ", "X.....XXXXX ", "X..X..X     ",
2352:      "X.X X..X    ", "XX  X..X    ", "X    XX     ", "     XX     "};
2353:  int c_h = 16;
2354:  int c_w = 12;
2355:  for (int y = 0; y < c_h; y++) {
2356:    for (int x = 0; x < c_w; x++) {
2357:      int px = mouse_x + x;
2358:      int py = mouse_y + y;
2359:      if (px >= 0 && px < bb_w && py >= 0 && py < bb_h) {
2360:        char p = cursor_bits[y][x];
2361:        if (p == 'X')
2362:          backbuffer[py * bb_w + px] = 0xFFFFFFFF; // Border White
2363:        else if (p == '.')
2364:          backbuffer[py * bb_w + px] = 0xFF000000; // Fill Black
2365:      }
2366:    }
2367:  }
2368:
2369:  /* Flush — upload only the damage bounding box.  Prefer the atomic present()
2370:   * (RC2): it copies backbuffer->scanout AND transfers to the host under the
2371:   * driver's gpu_lock, so a concurrent set_mode/zoom can't free the scanout
2372:   * backing mid-copy (the resize/zoom use-after-free).  present() validates the
2373:   * source geometry against the LIVE scanout and returns <0 to skip a frame on
2374:   * a mid-resize mismatch — we then leave the damage accumulated so the next
2375:   * frame repaints at the new size. */
2376:  int presented = 0;
2377:  int dx1 = damage_x1 < 0 ? 0 : damage_x1;
2378:  int dy1 = damage_y1 < 0 ? 0 : damage_y1;
2379:  int dx2 = damage_x2 > bb_w ? bb_w : damage_x2;
2380:  int dy2 = damage_y2 > bb_h ? bb_h : damage_y2;
2381:  if (dev->ops && dev->ops->present) {
2382:    if (dx1 < dx2 && dy1 < dy2) {
2383:      /* Surface-speaking contract (graphics-port): the core hands the
2384:       * provider its validated gfx_surface + damage rect through gpu_core,
2385:       * never the driver's ops table directly.  Re-bind immediately before
2386:       * present so a clobbered descriptor cannot reach the GPU seam even if
2387:       * something scribbled over compositor_frame_surface mid-frame. */
2388:      compositor_bind_backbuffer_surface(bb_w, bb_h, bb_pg, backbuffer);
2389:      gfx_surface_verify(screen, "compositor_render_internal/present");
2390:      gfx_rect_t present_damage = {dx1, dy1, dx2 - dx1, dy2 - dy1};
2391:      if (gpu_present_surface(screen, &present_damage) == 0)
2392:        presented = 1;
2393:    } else {
2394:      presented = 1; /* nothing to upload, but the (empty) damage is consumed */
2395:    }
2396:  } else if (dev->ops && dev->ops->flush && dev->ops->get_framebuffer) {
2397:    /* Legacy fallback for a driver without present(): copy+flush.  NOT atomic
2398:     * vs set_mode, but no GPU driver in-tree lacks present() — kept for safety
2399:     * so a future provider that only implements flush still displays. */
2400:    void *fb_va = dev->ops->get_framebuffer(dev, NULL);
2401:    if (fb_va && bb_w == dev->width && bb_h == dev->height) {
2402:      if (dx1 < dx2 && dy1 < dy2) {
2403:        int row_bytes = (dx2 - dx1) * 4;
2404:        uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)fb_va;
2405:        const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)backbuffer;
2406:        for (int row = dy1; row < dy2; row++) {
2407:          memcpy(dst + ((size_t)row * bb_w + dx1) * 4,
2408:                 src + ((size_t)row * bb_w + dx1) * 4, row_bytes);
2409:        }
2410:        dev->ops->flush(dev, dx1, dy1, dx2 - dx1, dy2 - dy1);
2411:      }
2412:      presented = 1;
2413:    }
2414:  }
2415:  /* Reset damage only once the frame was actually presented; a skipped frame
2416:   * (mid-resize geometry mismatch) keeps its damage for the retry. */
2417:  if (presented) {
2418:    damage_x1 = bb_w;
2419:    damage_y1 = bb_h;
2420:    damage_x2 = 0;
2421:    damage_y2 = 0;
2422:  }
2423:  /* Cleanup regions (occluded was destroyed after pass 1; visible_regions
2424:   * entries are nulled as pass 2 consumes them). */
2425:  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
2426:    if (visible_regions[i]) {
2427:      region_destroy(visible_regions[i]);
2428:      visible_regions[i] = NULL;
2429:    }
2430:  }
2431:
2432:  __sync_lock_release(&in_render);
2433:}
2434:
2435:/*
2436: * Composite All Windows to Screen (Public - Locks)
2437: */
2438:void compositor_render(void) {
2439:  uint64_t flags;
2440:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
2441:  compositor_render_internal();
2442:  compositor_dirty = 0;
2443:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2444:}
2445:
2446:/*
2447: * Compositor Tick - Called from timer interrupt
2448: * Renders if dirty flag is set (avoids re-render on every event)
2449: */
2450:void compositor_tick(void) {
2451:  uint64_t flags;
2452:  /* Use trylock to avoid blocking timer IRQ if compositor is busy */
2453:  if (spin_trylock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags)) {
2454:    if (compositor_dirty) {
2455:      compositor_dirty = 0;
2456:      compositor_render_internal();
2457:    }
2458:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2459:  }
2460:}
2461:
2462:/*
2463: * Draw to Window
2464: */
2465:/*
2466: * Draw to Window (Internal - No Locking)
2467: */
2468:static void draw_rect_internal(int window_id, int x, int y, int w, int h,
2469:                               uint32_t color, int caller_pid) {
2470:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
2471:    if (windows[i].id == window_id && windows[i].buffer) {
2472:      /* Process Isolation: Verify Ownership */
2473:      if (windows[i].pid != caller_pid &&
2474:          caller_pid != 1) { /* PID 1 is root/init */
2475:        pr_warn(
2476:            "Compositor: Process %d tried to draw to window %d (owned by %d)\n",
2477:            caller_pid, window_id, windows[i].pid);
2478:        return;
2479:      }
2480:
2481:      for (int dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
2482:        for (int dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
2483:          int px = x + dx;
2484:          int py = y + dy;
2485:          /* Strict bounds checking using window dimensions */
2486:          if (px >= 0 && px < windows[i].width && py >= 0 &&
2487:              py < windows[i].height) {
2488:            /* Final safety check: ensure window buffer is non-null */
2489:            if (windows[i].buffer) {
2490:              windows[i].buffer[py * windows[i].width + px] = color;
2491:            }
2492:          }
2493:        }
2494:      }
2495:      if ((color >> 24) != 0xFF) {
2496:        windows[i].has_alpha = 1;
2497:      } else if (x <= 0 && y <= 0 && w >= windows[i].width &&
2498:                 h >= windows[i].height) {
2499:        windows[i].has_alpha = 0;
2500:      }
2501:
2502:      expand_window_content_damage(&windows[i], x, y, w, h);
2503:      return;
2504:    }
2505:  }
2506:}
2507:
2508:/*
2509: * Draw to Window (Public - Locks)
2510: */
2511:void compositor_draw_rect(int window_id, int x, int y, int w, int h,
2512:                          uint32_t color, int caller_pid) {
2513:  uint64_t flags;
2514:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
2515:  draw_rect_internal(window_id, x, y, w, h, color, caller_pid);
2516:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2517:}
2518:
2519:/*
2520: * Blit user buffer to window
2521: */
2522:void compositor_blit(int window_id, int x, int y, int w, int h,
2523:                     const uint32_t *user_buf, int caller_pid) {
2524:  // pr_info("BLIT: win=%d pid=%d buf=%p %dx%d\n", window_id, caller_pid,
2525:  // user_buf, w, h);
2526:  uint64_t flags;
2527:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
2528:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
2529:    if (windows[i].id == window_id && windows[i].buffer) {
2530:      /* Process Isolation: Verify Ownership */
2531:      if (windows[i].pid != caller_pid && caller_pid != 1) {
2532:        spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2533:        return;
2534:      }
2535:
2536:      int copied_x1 = windows[i].width;
2537:      int copied_y1 = windows[i].height;
2538:      int copied_x2 = 0;
2539:      int copied_y2 = 0;
2540:
2541:      /* Copy Logic: Row by Row for speed */
2542:      for (int dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
2543:        int py = y + dy;
2544:        /* Clip Y */
2545:        if (py < 0 || py >= windows[i].height)
2546:          continue;
2547:
2548:        /* Calculate source and dest pointers for the row */
2549:        /* We assume x=0 for full width blit usually, but handle x offset */
2550:
2551:        /* Clip X roughly: we support full width blit mainly */
2552:        /* If x < 0, we need to skip source pixels?
2553:           For this syscall, let's assume valid bounds or simple clipping. */
2554:
2555:        /* Destination X start */
2556:        int dest_x = x;
2557:        int src_x = 0;
2558:        int copy_w = w;
2559:
2560:        if (dest_x < 0) {
2561:          src_x += -dest_x;
2562:          copy_w -= -dest_x;
2563:          dest_x = 0;
2564:        }
2565:
2566:        if (dest_x + copy_w > windows[i].width) {
2567:          copy_w = windows[i].width - dest_x;
2568:        }
2569:
2570:        if (copy_w <= 0)
2571:          continue;
2572:
2573:        /* Use copy_from_user instead of raw memcpy for security */
2574:        void *dst_ptr = &windows[i].buffer[py * windows[i].width + dest_x];
2575:        const void *src_ptr = &user_buf[dy * w + src_x];
2576:
2577:        if (vmm_copy_from_user(dst_ptr, src_ptr, copy_w * sizeof(uint32_t)) !=
2578:            0) {
2579:          /* Page fault or invalid access: abort blit */
2580:          spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2581:          return;
2582:        }
2583:        if (dest_x < copied_x1)
2584:          copied_x1 = dest_x;
2585:        if (py < copied_y1)
2586:          copied_y1 = py;
2587:        if (dest_x + copy_w > copied_x2)
2588:          copied_x2 = dest_x + copy_w;
2589:        if (py + 1 > copied_y2)
2590:          copied_y2 = py + 1;
2591:      }
2592:
2593:      if (copied_x2 > copied_x1 && copied_y2 > copied_y1) {
2594:        int cw = copied_x2 - copied_x1;
2595:        int ch = copied_y2 - copied_y1;
2596:        int copied_has_alpha =
2597:            window_region_has_alpha(&windows[i], copied_x1, copied_y1, cw, ch);
2598:        if (copied_has_alpha) {
2599:          windows[i].has_alpha = 1;
2600:        } else if (copied_x1 == 0 && copied_y1 == 0 &&
2601:                   copied_x2 >= windows[i].width &&
2602:                   copied_y2 >= windows[i].height) {
2603:          windows[i].has_alpha = 0;
2604:        }
2605:        expand_window_content_damage(&windows[i], copied_x1, copied_y1, cw, ch);
2606:      }
2607:
2608:      spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2609:      return;
2610:    }
2611:  }
2612:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2613:}
2614:
2615:void compositor_set_window_flags(int window_id, int flags_val) {
2616:  uint64_t flags;
2617:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
2618:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
2619:    if (windows[i].id == window_id) {
2620:      windows[i].top_most = (flags_val & 1) ? 1 : 0;
2621:      windows[i].passive = (flags_val & 8) ? 1 : 0; /* bit 3: click-through */
2622:      if (flags_val & 4)
2623:        windows[i].visible = 0; /* bit 2: hide window */
2624:      else if (flags_val & 2)
2625:        windows[i].visible = 1; /* bit 1: show window */
2626:      /* Damage the window's footprint so the show/hide/restack is actually
2627:       * composited + flushed on the next render.  Without this the state
2628:       * changed but the damage box stayed empty, so the popup only refreshed
2629:       * when some OTHER event (the mouse passing over it) damaged that region —
2630:       * the "notification sticks / won't disappear until I move the mouse" bug.
2631:       * Same footprint math as compositor_destroy_windows_by_pid. */
2632:      {
2633:        int ddw = windows[i].draw_w > 0 ? windows[i].draw_w : windows[i].width;
2634:        int ddh = windows[i].draw_h > 0 ? windows[i].draw_h : windows[i].height;
2635:        expand_damage(windows[i].x, windows[i].y - compositor_titlebar_height(),
2636:                      ddw, ddh + compositor_titlebar_height());
2637:        compositor_dirty = 1;
2638:      }
2639:      break;
2640:    }
2641:  }
2642:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
2643:}

1:/*
2: * kernel/graphics/compositor.c
3: * Window Compositor – Material Design 3 Convergent UI
4: *
5: * Manages windows and composites them to the screen.
6: *
7: * UI changes (logic untouched):
8: *   - ui_profile_t: desktop/mobile policy struct with percentage-based sizes.
9: *   - TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT / CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE: now computed from GPU resolution
10: *     at init time (6 % screen_h and 55 % title-bar-height respectively).
11: *   - WIN_CORNER_RADIUS: derived from corner_radius_pct × base_unit.
12: *   - Background gradient: MD3 light theme (COLOR_BG_TOP → COLOR_BG_BOTTOM)
13: *     instead of the previous dark-blue gradient.
14: *   - Window shadow: three-layer darkening pass rendered before each window.
15: *   - Titlebar: 1-px MD3 separator at bottom; rounded top corners; outer ring
16: *     on the close button.
17: *   - Content area: rounded bottom corners (pixels outside the radius are
18: *     skipped so the background shows through).
19: */

41: * ui_profile_t describes the active desktop/mobile rendering policy.
42: * All visual measurements are expressed as percentages of base_unit
43: * (= min(screen_w, screen_h) / 100).  The compositor selects one profile
44: * at init time based on the GPU resolution; applications run unchanged on
45: * both form factors.

47: * Values follow the specification in the technical document:
48: *   Desktop: scale 1.0×, 2 % padding, 2 % corner radius, 300 ms animation.
49: *   Mobile : scale 1.75×, 4 % padding, 4 % corner radius, 400 ms animation.

148:/*
149: * compositor_base_unit - 1 % of the smaller screen dimension in pixels.
150: *
151: * base_unit% = min(screen_w, screen_h) / 100.0f   (spec §2)
152: * All percentage-based sizes are computed as  N × compositor_base_unit().
153: */
154:static inline int compositor_base_unit(void) {
155:  struct gpu_device *dev = gpu_get_primary();
156:  if (!dev)
157:    return 8;
158:  int m = dev->width < dev->height ? dev->width : dev->height;
159:  int bu = m / 100;
160:  return (bu < 1) ? 1 : bu;
161:}

313:/* Helper to expand damage region */
314:static void expand_damage(int x, int y, int w, int h) {
315:  if (x < damage_x1)
316:    damage_x1 = x;
317:  if (y < damage_y1)
318:    damage_y1 = y;
319:  if (x + w > damage_x2)
320:    damage_x2 = x + w;
321:  if (y + h > damage_y2)
322:    damage_y2 = y + h;
323:  compositor_dirty = 1;
324:}

339:/*
340: * UI Dimensions – computed from GPU resolution in compositor_init().
341: *
342: *   TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT  = screen_h × 6 %, clamped [24, 40]   (spec §4)
343: *   CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE = TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT × 55 %, clamped [12, 22]
344: *   WIN_CORNER_RADIUS = corner_radius_pct × base_unit, clamped [4, 16]
345: *
346: * Declared as plain ints (not #defines) so they can be set at runtime from
347: * the actual framebuffer dimensions rather than a compile-time guess.
348: */
349:static int TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT = 28;
350:static int CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE = 14;
351:static int WIN_CORNER_RADIUS = 8;
352:
353:/* Global backbuffer – pre-allocated; size is set from GPU in compositor_init */
354:static uint32_t *compositor_backbuffer = NULL;
355:static int bb_width = 0;
356:static int bb_height = 0;
357:
358:/* =========================================================================
359: * Initialize Compositor
360: * ========================================================================= */
361:void compositor_init(void) {
362:  memset(windows, 0, sizeof(windows));
363:  window_count = 0;
364:  next_window_id = 100;
365:
366:  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
367:   * Derive percentage-based UI dimensions from the actual GPU resolution.
368:   * Falls back to 1280 × 720 when no GPU is detected yet.
369:   * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
370:  {
371:    struct gpu_device *dev = gpu_get_primary();
372:    int sw = dev ? dev->width : 1280;
373:    int sh = dev ? dev->height : 720;
374:
375:    /* Profile selection: ≤ 600 px wide → mobile, otherwise desktop */
376:    ui_profile = (sw <= 600) ? &ui_mobile : &ui_desktop;
377:
378:    /* base_unit = 1 % of the smaller screen axis (spec §2) */
379:    int bu = (sw < sh ? sw : sh) / 100;
380:    if (bu < 1)
381:      bu = 1;
382:
383:    /* Title bar: 6 % of screen height, clamped [24, 40] */
384:    TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT = (sh * 6) / 100;
385:    if (TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT < 24)
386:      TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT = 24;
387:    if (TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT > 40)
388:      TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT = 40;
389:
390:    /* Close button: 55 % of title bar height, clamped [12, 22] */
391:    CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE = (TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT * 60) / 100;
392:    if (CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE < 12)
393:      CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE = 12;
394:    if (CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE > 22)
395:      CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE = 22;
396:
397:    /* Corner radius: corner_radius_pct × base_unit, clamped [4, 16] */
398:    WIN_CORNER_RADIUS = (ui_profile->corner_radius_pct * bu);
399:    if (WIN_CORNER_RADIUS < 4)
400:      WIN_CORNER_RADIUS = 4;
401:    if (WIN_CORNER_RADIUS > 16)
402:      WIN_CORNER_RADIUS = 16;
403:
404:    bb_width = sw;
405:    bb_height = sh;
406:  }
407:
408:  compositor_backbuffer = kmalloc(bb_width * bb_height * 4);
409:
410:  /* Initialise damage rect to full screen so the first frame is fully uploaded
411:   */
412:  damage_x1 = 0;
413:  damage_y1 = 0;
414:  damage_x2 = bb_width;
415:  damage_y2 = bb_height;
416:
417:  if (!compositor_backbuffer) {
418:    pr_err("%s", "Compositor: Failed to allocate backbuffer!\n");
419:  }
420:
421:  pr_info(
422:      "Compositor: Initialized (%dx%d profile=%s titlebar=%dpx corner=%dpx)\n",
423:      bb_width, bb_height, (ui_profile == &ui_desktop) ? "desktop" : "mobile",
424:      TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT, WIN_CORNER_RADIUS);
425:}
426:
427:/* Forward Declarations */
428:static void compositor_render_internal(void);
429:static void draw_rect_internal(int window_id, int x, int y, int w, int h,
430:                               uint32_t color, int caller_pid);
431:
432:/* =========================================================================
433: * Create Window
434: * ========================================================================= */
435:int compositor_create_window(int x, int y, int w, int h, const char *title,
436:                             int pid) {
437:  uint64_t flags;
438:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
439:
440:  if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 4096 || h > 4096) {
441:    pr_err("Compositor: Invalid window dimensions %dx%d\n", w, h);
442:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
443:    return -1;
444:  }
445:
446:  if (window_count >= MAX_WINDOWS) {
447:    pr_err("%s", "Compositor: Max windows reached\n");
448:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
449:    return -1;
450:  }
451:
452:  /* Find free slot */
453:  int slot = -1;
454:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
455:    if (windows[i].id == 0) {
456:      slot = i;
457:      break;
458:    }
459:  }
460:
461:  if (slot < 0) {
462:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
463:    return -1;
464:  }
465:
466:  /*
467:   * FIX(GFX-COMP-NEWWIN-01): clamp the initial position so a newly created
468:   * window (including its title bar / close button) lands fully on-screen.
469:   */
470:  {
471:    struct gpu_device *screen_dev = gpu_get_primary();
472:    int screen_w = screen_dev ? screen_dev->width : 800;
473:    int screen_h = screen_dev ? screen_dev->height : 600;
474:
475:    if (x + w > screen_w)
476:      x = screen_w - w;
477:    if (x < 0)
478:      x = 0;
479:
480:    if (y + h > screen_h)
481:      y = screen_h - h;
482:    if (y < TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT)
483:      y = TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT;
484:  }
485:
486:  /* Allocate window buffer */
487:  size_t buffer_size = w * h * sizeof(uint32_t);
488:  uint32_t *buffer = (uint32_t *)kmalloc(buffer_size);
489:  if (!buffer) {
490:    pr_err("%s", "Compositor: Failed to allocate window buffer\n");
491:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
492:    return -1;
493:  }
494:  uint32_t default_bg = COLOR_WIN_BG;
495:  for (int i = 0; i < w * h; i++)
496:    buffer[i] = default_bg;
497:
498:  /* Initialize window */
499:  windows[slot].id = next_window_id++;
500:  windows[slot].x = x;
501:  windows[slot].y = y;
502:  windows[slot].width = w;
503:  windows[slot].height = h;
504:  windows[slot].z_order = window_count;
505:  windows[slot].visible = 1;
506:  windows[slot].pid = pid;
507:  windows[slot].buffer = buffer;
508:  windows[slot].bg_color = default_bg;
509:  windows[slot].curr_bg_color = default_bg;
510:
511:  /* Initialize text grids using dynamic font metrics */
512:  int char_w = graphics_font_max_width();
513:  int char_h = graphics_font_height();
514:  windows[slot].grid_cols = w / char_w;
515:  windows[slot].grid_rows = h / char_h;
516:  size_t grid_size = windows[slot].grid_cols * windows[slot].grid_rows;
517:  windows[slot].text_grid = (uint8_t *)kmalloc(grid_size);
518:  windows[slot].attr_grid = (uint32_t *)kmalloc(grid_size * 4);
519:  if (windows[slot].text_grid && windows[slot].attr_grid) {
520:    memset(windows[slot].text_grid, ' ', grid_size);
521:    for (size_t i = 0; i < grid_size; i++)
522:      windows[slot].attr_grid[i] = COLOR_FG;
523:  } else {
524:    if (windows[slot].text_grid)
525:      kfree(windows[slot].text_grid);
526:    if (windows[slot].attr_grid)
527:      kfree(windows[slot].attr_grid);
528:    kfree(buffer);
529:    windows[slot].id = 0;
530:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
531:    return -1;
532:  }
533:
534:  /* Copy title */
535:  int len = 0;
536:  while (title[len] && len < 63) {
537:    windows[slot].title[len] = title[len];
538:    len++;
539:  }
540:  windows[slot].title[len] = '\0';
541:
542:  /* Initialize terminal state */
543:  windows[slot].cursor_x = 0;
544:  windows[slot].cursor_y = 0;
545:  windows[slot].cursor_visible = 1;
546:  windows[slot].caret_shown = 0;
547:  windows[slot].caret_px = 0;
548:  windows[slot].caret_py = 0;
549:  windows[slot].fg_color = COLOR_FG;
550:  windows[slot].escape_state = 0;
551:  windows[slot].escape_len = 0;
552:
553:  windows[slot].has_alpha = 1;
554:
555:  /* Clear buffer to background */
556:  for (int i = 0; i < w * h; i++)
557:    buffer[i] = windows[slot].bg_color;
558:
559:  /* Mark main shell (PID 2) as protected */
560:  windows[slot].protected = (pid == 2) ? 1 : 0;
561:  windows[slot].top_most = 0;
562:
563:  window_count++;
564:
565:  pr_info("Compositor: Created window '%s' (%dx%d) at (%d,%d)\n", title, w, h,
566:          x, y);
567:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
568:  return windows[slot].id;
569:}
570:
571:/*
572: * __focus_topmost_locked - re-point keyboard focus after a window goes away.
573: */
574:static void __clear_other_carets_locked(int keep_pid);
575:
576:static void __focus_topmost_locked(void) {
577:  int max_z = -1;
578:  int pid = 7; /* shell default when no window remains */
579:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
580:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].visible &&
581:        windows[i].z_order > max_z) {
582:      max_z = windows[i].z_order;
583:      pid = windows[i].pid;
584:    }
585:  }
586:  keyboard_focus_pid = pid;
587:  __clear_other_carets_locked(pid);
588:  pr_debug("Compositor: Focus reset to PID %d\n", pid);
589:}

591:int compositor_window_owner(int window_id) {
592:  uint64_t flags;
593:  int owner = -1;
594:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
595:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
596:    if (windows[i].id == window_id) {
597:      owner = windows[i].pid;
598:      break;
599:    }
600:  }
601:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
602:  return owner;
603:}

605:int compositor_window_grid(int window_id, int *cols, int *rows) {
606:  uint64_t flags;
607:  int found = -1;
608:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
609:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
610:    if (windows[i].id == window_id) {
611:      if (cols)
612:        *cols = windows[i].grid_cols;
613:      if (rows)
614:        *rows = windows[i].grid_rows;
615:      found = 0;
616:      break;
617:    }
618:  }
619:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
620:  return found;
621:}

623:/* =========================================================================
624: * Destroy Window
625: * ========================================================================= */
626:void compositor_destroy_window(int window_id) {
627:  uint64_t flags;
628:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
629:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
630:    if (windows[i].id == window_id) {
631:      int refocus = (windows[i].pid == keyboard_focus_pid);
632:      if (windows[i].buffer)
633:        kfree(windows[i].buffer);
634:      if (windows[i].text_grid)
635:        kfree(windows[i].text_grid);
636:      if (windows[i].attr_grid)
637:        kfree(windows[i].attr_grid);
638:      memset(&windows[i], 0, sizeof(struct window));
639:      window_count--;
640:      if (refocus)
641:        __focus_topmost_locked();
642:      spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
643:      return;
644:    }
645:  }
646:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
647:}

649:void compositor_destroy_windows_by_pid(int pid) {
650:  uint64_t flags;
651:  int refocus = 0;
652:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
653:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
654:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].pid == pid) {
655:      if (windows[i].pid == keyboard_focus_pid)
656:        refocus = 1;
657:      if (windows[i].buffer)
658:        kfree(windows[i].buffer);
659:      if (windows[i].text_grid)
660:        kfree(windows[i].text_grid);
661:      if (windows[i].attr_grid)
662:        kfree(windows[i].attr_grid);
663:      memset(&windows[i], 0, sizeof(struct window));
664:      window_count--;
665:    }
666:  }
667:  if (refocus)
668:    __focus_topmost_locked();
669:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
670:}
