680:int compositor_get_window_by_pid(int pid) {
681:  uint64_t flags;
682:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
683:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
684:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].pid == pid) {
685:      int id = windows[i].id;
686:      spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
687:      return id;
688:    }
689:  }
690:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
691:  return -1;

694:int compositor_get_focus_pid(void) {
695:  uint64_t flags;
696:  if (!spin_trylock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags))
697:    return -1;
698:  int max_z = -1, pid = -1;
699:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
700:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].visible) {
701:      if (windows[i].z_order > max_z) {
702:        max_z = windows[i].z_order;
703:        pid = windows[i].pid;
704:      }
705:    }
706:  }
707:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
708:  return pid;
709:}

720:
721:/* =========================================================================
722: * Alpha blend two colors
723: * ========================================================================= */
724:static inline uint32_t blend_pixel(uint32_t fg, uint32_t bg) {
725:  uint32_t alpha = (fg >> 24) & 0xFF;
726:  if (alpha == 255)
727:    return fg;
728:  if (alpha == 0)
729:    return bg;
730:  uint32_t inv_alpha = 255 - alpha;
731:  uint32_t r =
732:      (((fg >> 16) & 0xFF) * alpha + ((bg >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv_alpha) >> 8;
733:  uint32_t g =
734:      (((fg >> 8) & 0xFF) * alpha + ((bg >> 8) & 0xFF) * inv_alpha) >> 8;
735:  uint32_t b = ((fg & 0xFF) * alpha + (bg & 0xFF) * inv_alpha) >> 8;
736:  return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
737:}
738:
739:/* =========================================================================
740: * Process ANSI SGR (Select Graphic Rendition) parameters
741: * ========================================================================= */
742:static void handle_sgr(struct window *win) {
743:  if (win->escape_len == 0) {
744:    win->fg_color = COLOR_FG;
745:    return;
746:  }
747:  int val = 0;
748:  for (int i = 0; i < win->escape_len; i++) {
749:    if (win->escape_buf[i] >= '0' && win->escape_buf[i] <= '9')
750:      val = val * 10 + (win->escape_buf[i] - '0');
751:  }
752:  if (val == 0) {
753:    win->fg_color = COLOR_FG;
754:    win->curr_bg_color = win->bg_color;
755:  } else if (val == 39) {
756:    win->fg_color = COLOR_FG;
757:  } else if (val == 49) {
758:    win->curr_bg_color = win->bg_color;
759:  } else if (val >= 30 && val <= 37) {
760:    uint32_t colors[] = {0xFF000000, 0xFFBB0000, 0xFF00BB00, 0xFFBBBB00,
761:                         0xFF0000BB, 0xFFBB00BB, 0xFF00BBBB, 0xFFBBBBBB};
762:    win->fg_color = colors[val - 30];
763:  } else if (val >= 40 && val <= 47) {
764:    uint32_t colors[] = {0xFF000000, 0xFFBB0000, 0xFF00BB00, 0xFFBBBB00,
765:                         0xFF0000BB, 0xFFBB00BB, 0xFF00BBBB, 0xFFBBBBBB};
766:    win->curr_bg_color = colors[val - 40];
767:  } else if (val >= 90 && val <= 97) {
768:    uint32_t colors[] = {0xFF555555, 0xFFFF5555, 0xFF55FF55, 0xFFFFFF55,
769:                         0xFF5555FF, 0xFFFF55FF, 0xFF55FFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF};
770:    win->fg_color = colors[val - 90];
771:  } else if (val >= 100 && val <= 107) {
772:    uint32_t colors[] = {0xFF555555, 0xFFFF5555, 0xFF55FF55, 0xFFFFFF55,
773:                         0xFF5555FF, 0xFFFF55FF, 0xFF55FFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF};
774:    win->curr_bg_color = colors[val - 100];
775:  }
776:}
777:
778:static int csi_params(const char *buf, int len, int *a, int *b) {
779:  int vals[2] = {0, 0};
780:  int which = 0, have = 0;
781:  for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
782:    char c = buf[i];
783:    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
784:      vals[which] = vals[which] * 10 + (c - '0');
785:      have = 1;
786:    } else if (c == ';' && which < 1)
787:      which++;
788:  }
789:  *a = vals[0];
790:  *b = vals[1];
791:  return have ? which + 1 : 0;
792:}
793:
794:static void term_clear_cell(int win_id, struct window *win, int cx, int cy,
795:                            int char_w, int char_h) {
796:  if (cx < 0 || cy < 0 || cx >= win->grid_cols || cy >= win->grid_rows)
797:    return;
798:  draw_rect_internal(win_id, cx * char_w, cy * char_h, char_w, char_h,
799:                     win->curr_bg_color, 1);
800:  if (win->text_grid && win->attr_grid) {
801:    int idx = cy * win->grid_cols + cx;
802:    win->text_grid[idx] = ' ';
803:    win->attr_grid[idx] = win->curr_bg_color;
804:  }
805:}
806:
807:static void term_erase_caret(int win_id, struct window *win,
808:                             struct gl_surface *surf, int char_w, int char_h) {
809:  if (!win->caret_shown)
810:    return;
811:  int px = win->caret_px, py = win->caret_py;
812:  win->caret_shown = 0;
813:  if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= win->grid_cols || py >= win->grid_rows)
814:    return;
815:  draw_rect_internal(win_id, px * char_w, py * char_h, char_w, char_h,
816:                     win->bg_color, 1);
817:  if (win->text_grid && win->attr_grid) {
818:    int idx = py * win->grid_cols + px;
819:    char ch = (char)win->text_grid[idx];
820:    if (ch >= 32 && ch < 127)
821:      gl_draw_char(surf, px * char_w, py * char_h, ch, win->attr_grid[idx]);
822:  }
823:}
824:
825:static void term_draw_cursor(int win_id, struct window *win,
826:                             struct gl_surface *surf, int char_w, int char_h) {
827:  extern int keyboard_focus_pid;
828:  term_erase_caret(win_id, win, surf, char_w, char_h);
829:  if (!win->cursor_visible || win->pid != keyboard_focus_pid)
830:    return;
831:  int cx = win->cursor_x, cy = win->cursor_y;
832:  if (cx < 0 || cy < 0 || cx >= win->grid_cols || cy >= win->grid_rows)
833:    return;
834:  const uint32_t caret = COLOR_CARET;
835:  int px0 = cx * char_w, py0 = cy * char_h;
836:  for (int y = 0; y < char_h; y++) {
837:    int sy = py0 + y;
838:    if (sy < 0 || sy >= win->height)
839:      continue;
840:    for (int x = 0; x < char_w; x++) {
841:      int sx = px0 + x;
842:      if (sx < 0 || sx >= win->width)
843:        continue;
844:      uint32_t *p = &surf->buffer[sy * surf->stride + sx];
845:      *p = blend_pixel(caret, *p);
846:    }
847:  }
848:  win->caret_px = cx;
849:  win->caret_py = cy;
850:  win->caret_shown = 1;
851:}
852:
853:static void __clear_other_carets_locked(int keep_pid) {
854:  int char_w = graphics_font_max_width();
855:  int char_h = graphics_font_height();
856:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
857:    struct window *win = &windows[i];
858:    if (win->id == 0 || !win->caret_shown || win->pid == keep_pid)
859:      continue;
860:    struct gl_surface s = {.width = win->width,
861:                           .height = win->height,
862:                           .stride = win->width,
863:                           .buffer = win->buffer};
864:    term_erase_caret(win->id, win, &s, char_w, char_h);
865:    expand_damage(win->x, win->y - TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT, win->width,
866:                  win->height + TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT);
867:    compositor_dirty = 1;
868:  }
869:}
870:
871:void compositor_focus_changed(int new_pid) {
872:  uint64_t flags;
873:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
874:  __clear_other_carets_locked(new_pid);
875:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
876:}
877:
878:static void handle_csi(int win_id, struct window *win, char final, int char_w,
879:                       int char_h) {
880:  const char *eb = win->escape_buf;
881:  int len = win->escape_len;
882:
883:  if (len > 0 && eb[0] == '?') {
884:    int a, b;
885:    csi_params(eb + 1, len - 1, &a, &b);
886:    if (a == 25)
887:      win->cursor_visible = (final == 'h');
888:    return;
889:  }
890:  if (final == 'm') {
891:    handle_sgr(win);
892:    return;
893:  }
894:
895:  int a, b, n = csi_params(eb, len, &a, &b);
896:  if (final == 'H' || final == 'f') {
897:    int row = (n >= 1 && a > 0) ? a - 1 : 0;
898:    int col = (n >= 2 && b > 0) ? b - 1 : 0;
899:    if (row >= win->grid_rows)
900:      row = win->grid_rows - 1;
901:    if (col >= win->grid_cols)
902:      col = win->grid_cols - 1;
903:    win->cursor_y = row < 0 ? 0 : row;
904:    win->cursor_x = col < 0 ? 0 : col;
905:  } else if (final == 'K') {
906:    int mode = (n >= 1) ? a : 0;
907:    int x0 = (mode == 1) ? 0 : win->cursor_x;
908:    int x1 = (mode == 0) ? win->grid_cols - 1 : win->cursor_x;
909:    if (mode == 2) {
910:      x0 = 0;
911:      x1 = win->grid_cols - 1;
912:    }
913:    for (int x = x0; x <= x1; x++)
914:      term_clear_cell(win_id, win, x, win->cursor_y, char_w, char_h);
915:  } else if (final == 'J') {
916:    for (int p = 0; p < win->width * win->height; p++)
917:      win->buffer[p] = win->curr_bg_color;
918:    if (win->text_grid && win->attr_grid) {
919:      memset(win->text_grid, ' ', win->grid_cols * win->grid_rows);
920:      for (int p = 0; p < win->grid_cols * win->grid_rows; p++)
921:        win->attr_grid[p] = win->curr_bg_color;
922:    }
923:    win->cursor_x = 0;
924:    win->cursor_y = 0;
925:  }
926:}
927:
928:/* =========================================================================
929: * Write text to a window (Terminal Emulator)
930: * ========================================================================= */
931:void compositor_window_write(int win_id, const char *buf, size_t count) {
932:  uint64_t flags;
933:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
934:  struct window *win = NULL;
935:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
936:    if (windows[i].id == win_id) {
937:      win = &windows[i];
938:      break;
939:    }
940:  }
941:  if (win == NULL || win->buffer == NULL) {
942:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
943:    return;
944:  }
945:
946:  int char_w = graphics_font_max_width();
947:  int char_h = graphics_font_height();
948:  int cols = win->grid_cols;
949:  int rows = win->grid_rows;
950:
951:  struct gl_surface win_surf = {.width = win->width,
952:                                .height = win->height,
953:                                .stride = win->width,
954:                                .buffer = win->buffer};
955:
956:  for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
957:    char c = buf[i];
958:
959:    if (win->escape_state == 0) {
960:      if (c == '\033') {
961:        win->escape_state = 1;
962:        win->escape_len = 0;
963:      } else if (c == '\n') {
964:        win->cursor_x = 0;
965:        win->cursor_y++;
966:      } else if (c == '\r') {
967:        win->cursor_x = 0;
968:      } else if (c == '\b' || c == 127) {
969:        if (win->cursor_x > 0)
970:          win->cursor_x--;
971:      } else if (c >= 32 && c < 127) {
972:        if (win->cursor_x < 0)
973:          win->cursor_x = 0;
974:        if (win->cursor_y < 0)
975:          win->cursor_y = 0;
976:        if (win->cursor_x >= cols) {
977:          win->cursor_x = 0;
978:          win->cursor_y++;
979:        }
980:        if (win->cursor_y >= rows) {
981:          if (win->height > char_h) {
982:            size_t line_size = win->width * char_h;
983:            memmove(win->buffer, win->buffer + line_size,
984:                    win->width * (win->height - char_h) * 4);
985:          }
986:          for (int p = win->width * (win->height - char_h);
987:               p < win->width * win->height; p++)
988:            win->buffer[p] = win->bg_color;
989:          if (win->text_grid && win->attr_grid) {
990:            memmove(win->text_grid, win->text_grid + win->grid_cols,
991:                    win->grid_cols * (win->grid_rows - 1));
992:            memmove(win->attr_grid, win->attr_grid + win->grid_cols,
993:                    win->grid_cols * (win->grid_rows - 1) * 4);
994:            int last_row_start = win->grid_cols * (win->grid_rows - 1);
995:            memset(win->text_grid + last_row_start, ' ', win->grid_cols);
996:            for (int p = 0; p < win->grid_cols; p++)
997:              win->attr_grid[last_row_start + p] = COLOR_FG;
998:          }
999:          win->cursor_y = rows - 1;
1000:        }
1001:        draw_rect_internal(win_id, win->cursor_x * char_w,
1002:                           win->cursor_y * char_h, char_w, char_h,
1003:                           win->curr_bg_color, 1);
1004:        gl_draw_char(&win_surf, win->cursor_x * char_w, win->cursor_y * char_h,
1005:                     c, win->fg_color);
1006:        if (win->text_grid && win->attr_grid) {
1007:          int idx = win->cursor_y * win->grid_cols + win->cursor_x;
1008:          if (idx < win->grid_cols * win->grid_rows) {
1009:            win->text_grid[idx] = c;
1010:            win->attr_grid[idx] = win->fg_color;
1011:          }
1012:        }
1013:        win->cursor_x++;
1014:      }
1015:    } else if (win->escape_state == 1) {
1016:      if (c == '[')
1017:        win->escape_state = 2;
1018:      else
1019:        win->escape_state = 0;
1020:    } else if (win->escape_state == 2) {
1021:      if ((c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z')) {
1022:        handle_csi(win_id, win, c, char_w, char_h);
1023:        win->escape_state = 0;
1024:      } else if (win->escape_len < 31) {
1025:        win->escape_buf[win->escape_len++] = c;
1026:      } else {
1027:        win->escape_state = 0;
1028:      }
1029:    }
1030:  }
1031:
1032:  term_draw_cursor(win_id, win, &win_surf, char_w, char_h);
1033:  expand_damage(win->x, win->y - TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT, win->width,
1034:                win->height + TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT);
1035:  compositor_dirty = 1;
1036:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1037:}
1038:
1039:/* =========================================================================
1040: * Handle Mouse Click
1041: * ========================================================================= */
1042:void compositor_handle_click(int button, int state) {
1043:  (void)button;
1044:  if (state == 0) {
1045:    dragging_window_id = -1;
1046:    return;
1047:  }
1048:  if (state != 1)
1049:    return;
1050:
1051:  uint64_t flags;
1052:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1053:
1054:  struct window *hit = NULL;
1055:  int max_z = -1;
1056:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1057:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].visible) {
1058:      int title_top = windows[i].y - TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT;
1059:      if (mouse_x >= windows[i].x &&
1060:          mouse_x < windows[i].x + windows[i].width && mouse_y >= title_top &&
1061:          mouse_y < windows[i].y + windows[i].height) {
1062:        if (windows[i].z_order > max_z) {
1063:          max_z = windows[i].z_order;
1064:          hit = &windows[i];
1065:        }
1066:      }
1067:    }
1068:  }
1069:  if (!hit) {
1070:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1071:    return;
1072:  }
1073:
1074:  int top_z = 0;
1075:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1076:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].z_order > top_z)
1077:      top_z = windows[i].z_order;
1078:  }
1079:  hit->z_order = top_z + 1;
1080:
1081:  if (keyboard_focus_pid != hit->pid) {
1082:    pr_info("Compositor: Focus changed to PID %d (Window '%s')\n", hit->pid,
1083:            hit->title);
1084:    keyboard_focus_pid = hit->pid;
1085:  }
1086:
1087:  /* Capture work to deliver AFTER unlock (FIX GFX-COMP-03) */
1088:  int send_pid = -1;
1089:  struct ipc_message msg = {0};
1090:  if (keyboard_focus_pid > 0) {
1091:    msg.from = 0;
1092:    msg.type = IPC_TYPE_MOUSE;
1093:    msg.data1 = (uint64_t)button;
1094:    msg.data2 = (uint64_t)state;
1095:    int rel_x = mouse_x - hit->x;
1096:    int rel_y = mouse_y - hit->y;
1097:    memcpy(msg.payload, &rel_x, 4);
1098:    memcpy(msg.payload + 4, &rel_y, 4);
1099:    send_pid = keyboard_focus_pid;
1100:  }
1101:
1102:  int do_close = 0, close_pid = 0;
1103:  if (!hit->protected) {
1104:    int btn_x = hit->x + hit->width - CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE - 2;
1105:    int btn_y = hit->y - TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT + 2;
1106:    if (mouse_x >= btn_x && mouse_x < btn_x + CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE &&
1107:        mouse_y >= btn_y && mouse_y < btn_y + CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE) {
1108:      do_close = 1;
1109:      close_pid = hit->pid;
1110:    }
1111:  }
1112:
1113:  if (!do_close && mouse_y >= hit->y - TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT && mouse_y < hit->y) {
1114:    dragging_window_id = hit->id;
1115:    drag_off_x = mouse_x - hit->x;
1116:    drag_off_y = mouse_y - hit->y;
1117:  }
1118:
1119:  expand_damage(0, 0, bb_width, bb_height);
1120:  compositor_dirty = 1;
1121:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1122:
1123:  if (send_pid > 0)
1124:    kernel_ipc_send(send_pid, &msg);
1125:  if (do_close) {
1126:    pr_info("Compositor: Close button -> terminate PID %d\n", close_pid);
1127:    extern int process_terminate(int pid);
1128:    process_terminate(close_pid);
1129:  }
1130:}
1131:
1132:/* =========================================================================
1133: * Update Mouse Position
1134: * ========================================================================= */
1135:void compositor_update_mouse(int dx, int dy, int absolute) {
1136:  struct gpu_device *dev = gpu_get_primary();
1137:  int width = 800;
1138:  int height = 600;
1139:  if (dev) {
1140:    width = dev->width;
1141:    height = dev->height;
1142:  }
1143:
1144:  int old_mx = mouse_x, old_my = mouse_y;
1145:
1146:  if (absolute) {
1147:    if (dx >= 0)
1148:      mouse_x = (int)(((long)dx * (width - 1)) / INPUT_ABS_MAX);
1149:    if (dy >= 0)
1150:      mouse_y = (int)(((long)dy * (height - 1)) / INPUT_ABS_MAX);
1151:  } else {
1152:    mouse_x += dx;
1153:    mouse_y += dy;
1154:  }
1155:
1156:  if (mouse_x < 0)
1157:    mouse_x = 0;
1158:  if (mouse_x >= width)
1159:    mouse_x = width - 1;
1160:  if (mouse_y < 0)
1161:    mouse_y = 0;
1162:  if (mouse_y >= height)
1163:    mouse_y = height - 1;
1164:
1165:  if (dragging_window_id != -1) {
1166:    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1167:      if (windows[i].id == dragging_window_id) {
1168:        windows[i].x = mouse_x - drag_off_x;
1169:        windows[i].y = mouse_y - drag_off_y;
1170:        if (windows[i].x < 0)
1171:          windows[i].x = 0;
1172:        if (windows[i].x + windows[i].width > width)
1173:          windows[i].x = width - windows[i].width;
1174:        if (windows[i].y < TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT)
1175:          windows[i].y = TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT;
1176:        if (windows[i].y + windows[i].height > height)
1177:          windows[i].y = height - windows[i].height;
1178:        break;
1179:      }
1180:    }
1181:  }
1182:
1183:  if (dragging_window_id != -1) {
1184:    expand_damage(0, 0, bb_width, bb_height);
1185:  } else {
1186:    expand_damage(old_mx - 1, old_my - 1, 14, 18);
1187:    expand_damage(mouse_x - 1, mouse_y - 1, 14, 18);
1188:  }
1189:  compositor_dirty = 1;
1190:}
1191:
1192:/* =========================================================================
1193: * draw_window_shadow
1194: *
1195: * Renders a soft multi-layer drop shadow behind a window by darkening the
1196: * backbuffer with three concentric rectangles (outermost = lightest).
1197: * Shadow is offset 2 px right and 3 px down to suggest overhead lighting.
1198: *
1199: * Called once per non-top_most window in the bottom-up rendering pass,
1200: * BEFORE the window's own pixels are placed so the window content correctly
1201: * overdraws the shadow within its own bounds.
1202: *
1203: * The shadow radius equals WIN_CORNER_RADIUS / 2 (min 4 px).
1204: * ========================================================================= */
1205:static void draw_window_shadow(uint32_t *bb, int bb_w, int bb_h, int wx, int wy,
1206:                               int ww, int wh, int title_h) {
1207:  int elev = WIN_CORNER_RADIUS / 4;
1208:  if (elev < 2)
1209:    elev = 2;
1210:
1211:  int decor_y = wy - title_h;
1212:  int decor_h = wh + title_h;
1213:
1214:  /* Three concentric layers; alpha values from lightest to darkest */
1215:  static const int shadow_inv[3] = {254, 252, 250}; /* 255 * (1 - alpha) */
1216:
1217:  for (int layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
1218:    int spread = elev - layer;
1219:    if (spread <= 0)
1220:      continue;
1221:    int sx = wx - spread + 2;      /* 2-px horizontal offset */
1222:    int sy = decor_y - spread + 3; /* 3-px vertical offset   */
1223:    int sw = ww + spread * 2;
1224:    int sh = decor_h + spread * 2;
1225:    int inv = shadow_inv[layer];
1226:
1227:    for (int y = 0; y < sh; y++) {
1228:      int py = sy + y;
1229:      if (py < 0 || py >= bb_h)
1230:        continue;
1231:      for (int x = 0; x < sw; x++) {
1232:        int px = sx + x;
1233:        if (px < 0 || px >= bb_w)
1234:          continue;
1235:        uint32_t *p = &bb[py * bb_w + px];
1236:        uint32_t bg = *p;
1237:        uint32_t r = ((bg >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv / 255;
1238:        uint32_t g = ((bg >> 8) & 0xFF) * inv / 255;
1239:        uint32_t b = (bg & 0xFF) * inv / 255;
1240:        *p = 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
1241:      }
1242:    }
1243:  }
1244:}
1245:
1246:/* =========================================================================
1247: * Compositor Render (Region-based / Front-to-Back with Occlusion Culling)
1248: * ========================================================================= */
1249:#include <kernel/region.h>
1250:
1251:static volatile int in_render = 0;
1252:static void compositor_render_internal(void) {
1253:  if (__sync_lock_test_and_set(&in_render, 1))
1254:    return;
1255:
1256:  struct gpu_device *dev = gpu_get_primary();
1257:  if (!dev || !compositor_backbuffer) {
1258:    __sync_lock_release(&in_render);
1259:    return;
1260:  }
1261:
1262:  int bb_w = bb_width;
1263:  int bb_h = bb_height;
1264:  uint32_t *backbuffer = compositor_backbuffer;
1265:
1266:  struct gl_surface screen = {
1267:      .width = bb_w, .height = bb_h, .stride = bb_w, .buffer = backbuffer};
1268:
1269:  struct window **sorted = sorted_windows;
1270:  struct region **visible_regions = visible_regions_store;
1271:  memset(visible_regions, 0, sizeof(struct region *) * MAX_WINDOWS);
1272:
1273:  int count = 0;
1274:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS && count < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1275:    if (windows[i].id != 0 && windows[i].visible) {
1276:      if (windows[i].x >= bb_w || windows[i].y >= bb_h ||
1277:          windows[i].x + windows[i].width <= 0 ||
1278:          windows[i].y + windows[i].height <= 0)
1279:        continue;
1280:      sorted[count++] = &windows[i];
1281:    }
1282:  }
1283:
1284:  /* Bubble sort by z_order (ascending) */
1285:  for (int i = 0; i < count - 1; i++) {
1286:    for (int j = 0; j < count - i - 1; j++) {
1287:      if (sorted[j]->z_order > sorted[j + 1]->z_order) {
1288:        struct window *tmp = sorted[j];
1289:        sorted[j] = sorted[j + 1];
1290:        sorted[j + 1] = tmp;
1291:      }
1292:    }
1293:  }
1294:
1295:  /* Move top-most windows to end of sorted list */
1296:  int current_count = count;
1297:  for (int i = 0; i < current_count; i++) {
1298:    if (sorted[i]->top_most) {
1299:      struct window *tmp = sorted[i];
1300:      for (int k = i; k < current_count - 1; k++)
1301:        sorted[k] = sorted[k + 1];
1302:      sorted[current_count - 1] = tmp;
1303:      current_count--;
1304:      i--;
1305:    }
1306:  }
1307:
1308:  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
1309:   * Pass 1: Visibility Calculation (Top-Down)
1310:   * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
1311:  struct region *occluded = region_create();
1312:  if (!occluded) {
1313:    __sync_lock_release(&in_render);
1314:    return;
1315:  }
1316:
1317:  for (int i = count - 1; i >= 0 && i < MAX_WINDOWS; i--) {
1318:    struct window *win = sorted[i];
1319:    int win_y = win->top_most ? win->y : win->y - TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT;
1320:    int win_h = win->top_most ? win->height : win->height + TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT;
1321:
1322:    struct region *vis = region_create();
1323:    if (vis) {
1324:      region_add_rect(vis, win->x, win_y, win->width, win_h);
1325:      for (int r = 0; r < occluded->count; r++) {
1326:        struct rect *or = &occluded->rects[r];
1327:        region_subtract(vis, or->x, or->y, or->w, or->h);
1328:      }
1329:      region_intersect_rect(vis, 0, 0, bb_w, bb_h);
1330:    }
1331:    visible_regions[i] = vis;
1332:
1333:    if (!win->has_alpha)
1334:      region_add_rect(occluded, win->x, win_y, win->width, win_h);
1335:  }
1336:
1337:  /* Background region = full screen minus occluded area */
1338:  struct region *bg_region = region_create();
1339:  if (bg_region) {
1340:    region_add_rect(bg_region, 0, 0, bb_w, bb_h);
1341:    for (int r = 0; r < occluded->count; r++) {
1342:      struct rect *or = &occluded->rects[r];
1343:      region_subtract(bg_region, or->x, or->y, or->w, or->h);
1344:    }
1345:
1346:    /* Draw Background — gradiente verticale macOS-style, calcolato una volta
1347:     * per riga (COLOR_BG_TOP -> COLOR_BG_BOTTOM) invece che per pixel. */
1348:    for (int r = 0; r < bg_region->count; r++) {
1349:      struct rect *bg = &bg_region->rects[r];
1350:      for (int y = 0; y < bg->h; y++) {
1351:        for (int x = 0; x < bg->w; x++) {
1352:          int sy = bg->y + y;
1353:          int sx = bg->x + x;
1354:
1355:          /* Final backbuffer bounds safety check */
1356:          if (sx >= 0 && sx < bb_w && sy >= 0 && sy < bb_h) {
1357:            /* Proper Gradient Background */
1358:            uint32_t r_chk = 20;
1359:            uint32_t g_chk = 40 + (sy * 40 / bb_h);
1360:            uint32_t b_chk = 80 + (sy * 80 / bb_h);
1361:            backbuffer[sy * bb_w + sx] =
1362:                0xFF000000 | (r_chk << 16) | (g_chk << 8) | b_chk;
1363:          }
1364:        }
1365:      }
1366:    }
1367:    region_destroy(bg_region);
1368:  }
1369:  region_destroy(occluded);
1370:  occluded = NULL;
1371:
1372:  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
1373:   * Pass 2: Rendering (Bottom-Up – Painter's Algorithm with Clipping)
1374:   * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
1375:  for (int i = 0; i < count && i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1376:    struct window *win = sorted[i];
1377:    struct region *vis = visible_regions[i];
1378:
1379:    int title_h = win->top_most ? 0 : TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT;
1380:    int content_y = win->y;
1381:    int decor_y = win->y - title_h;
1382:
1383:    /* ----------------------------------------------------------------
1384:     * Window shadow: darken backbuffer before placing window pixels.
1385:     * Only non-top_most windows have elevation / shadow.
1386:     * ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
1387:    if (!win->top_most && vis && vis->count > 0)
1388:      draw_window_shadow(backbuffer, bb_w, bb_h, win->x, win->y, win->width,
1389:                         win->height, title_h);
1390:
1391:    if (vis) {
1392:      for (int r = 0; r < vis->count; r++) {
1393:        struct rect *vr = &vis->rects[r];
1394:
1395:        for (int dy = 0; dy < vr->h; dy++) {
1396:          for (int dx = 0; dx < vr->w; dx++) {
1397:            int screen_x = vr->x + dx;
1398:            int screen_y = vr->y + dy;
1399:            int screen_idx = screen_y * bb_w + screen_x;
1400:            int render = 1; /* skip flag for corner masking */
1401:
1402:            if (screen_y < content_y) {
1403:              /* --------------------------------------------------------
1404:               * Decoration Area (Title Bar)
1405:               * -------------------------------------------------------- */
1406:              if (screen_y >= decor_y) {
1407:
1408:                /* 1-px MD3 divider at bottom of title bar */
1409:                if (screen_y == content_y - 1) {
1410:                  backbuffer[screen_idx] = COLOR_TITLE_SEPARATOR;
1411:                  continue;
1412:                }
1413:
1414:                /* Rounded top corners of the window chrome */
1415:                if (render) {
1416:                  int cr = WIN_CORNER_RADIUS;
1417:                  int tlx = screen_x - win->x;
1418:                  int tly = screen_y - decor_y;
1419:                  if (tlx < cr && tly < cr) {
1420:                    int ddx = tlx - cr, ddy = tly - cr;
1421:                    if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy > cr * cr)
1422:                      render = 0;
1423:                  } else if (tlx >= win->width - cr && tly < cr) {
1424:                    int ddx = tlx - (win->width - cr - 1), ddy = tly - cr;
1425:                    if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy > cr * cr)
1426:                      render = 0;
1427:                  }
1428:                }
1429:
1430:                if (render) {
1431:                  /* Title bar base colour: active vs inactive */
1432:                  uint32_t title_color = (win->pid == keyboard_focus_pid)
1433:                                             ? COLOR_TITLE_ACTIVE
1434:                                             : COLOR_TITLE_INACTIVE;
1435:
1436:                  /* Close button with outer ring (macOS traffic-light style).
1437:                   * Position is the same as compositor_handle_click so the
1438:                   * visual exactly matches the click-target rectangle. */
1439:                  if (!win->protected) {
1440:                    int btn_cx =
1441:                        win->x + win->width - 2 - CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE / 2 - 2;
1442:                    int btn_cy = decor_y + 2 + CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE / 2 + 3;
1443:                    int ddx = screen_x - btn_cx;
1444:                    int ddy = screen_y - btn_cy;
1445:                    int radius = CLOSE_BUTTON_SIZE / 2 - 1;
1446:                    int ring_r = radius + 1;
1447:                    if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy <= ring_r * ring_r) {
1448:                      title_color = (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy <= radius * radius)
1449:                                        ? COLOR_CLOSE_BTN
1450:                                        : COLOR_CLOSE_BTN_RING;
1451:                    }
1452:                  }
1453:                  backbuffer[screen_idx] = title_color;
1454:                }
1455:                /* if render == 0: corner pixel → background already in buf */
1456:              }
1457:
1458:            } else {
1459:              /* --------------------------------------------------------
1460:               * Content Area
1461:               * -------------------------------------------------------- */
1462:              int win_local_x = screen_x - win->x;
1463:              int win_local_y = screen_y - win->y;
1464:
1465:              if (win_local_x >= 0 && win_local_x < win->width &&
1466:                  win_local_y >= 0 && win_local_y < win->height) {
1467:
1468:                /* Rounded bottom corners of the content area */
1469:                int cr = WIN_CORNER_RADIUS;
1470:                if (win_local_x < cr && win_local_y >= win->height - cr) {
1471:                  int ddx = win_local_x - cr;
1472:                  int ddy = win_local_y - (win->height - cr - 1);
1473:                  if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy > cr * cr)
1474:                    render = 0;
1475:                } else if (win_local_x >= win->width - cr &&
1476:                           win_local_y >= win->height - cr) {
1477:                  int ddx = win_local_x - (win->width - cr - 1);
1478:                  int ddy = win_local_y - (win->height - cr - 1);
1479:                  if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy > cr * cr)
1480:                    render = 0;
1481:                }
1482:
1483:                if (render) {
1484:                  if (win->buffer) {
1485:                    uint32_t pixel =
1486:                        win->buffer[win_local_y * win->width + win_local_x];
1487:                    backbuffer[screen_idx] =
1488:                        blend_pixel(pixel, backbuffer[screen_idx]);
1489:                  } else {
1490:                    backbuffer[screen_idx] =
1491:                        blend_pixel(win->bg_color, backbuffer[screen_idx]);
1492:                  }
1493:                }
1494:                /* if render == 0: corner pixel → background shows through */
1495:              }
1496:            }
1497:          } /* dx */
1498:        } /* dy */
1499:      }
1500:      region_destroy(vis);
1501:      visible_regions[i] = NULL;
1502:    }
1503:
1504:    /* Title text – centred, macOS-style active/inactive colour */
1505:    if (!win->top_most) {
1506:      int char_h = graphics_font_height();
1507:      int text_w = graphics_string_width(win->title);
1508:      int start_x = win->x + (win->width - text_w) / 2;
1509:      int start_y = decor_y + (TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT - char_h) / 2;
1510:      uint32_t text_color = (win->pid == keyboard_focus_pid)
1511:                                ? COLOR_TITLE_TEXT_ACTIVE
1512:                                : COLOR_TITLE_TEXT_INACTIVE;
1513:      gl_draw_string(&screen, start_x, start_y, win->title, text_color);
1514:    }
1515:  }
1516:
1517:  /* Cleanup any remaining regions */
1518:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1519:    if (visible_regions_store[i]) {
1520:      region_destroy(visible_regions_store[i]);
1521:      visible_regions_store[i] = NULL;
1522:    }
1523:  }
1524:
1525:  /* Mouse cursor (always on top) */
1526:  static const char *cursor_bits[] = {
1527:      "X           ", "XX          ", "X.X         ", "X..X        ",
1528:      "X...X       ", "X....X      ", "X.....X     ", "X......X    ",
1529:      "X.......X   ", "X........X  ", "X.....XXXXX ", "X..X..X     ",
1530:      "X.X X..X    ", "XX  X..X    ", "X    XX     ", "     XX     "};
1531:  for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) {
1532:    for (int x = 0; x < 12; x++) {
1533:      int px = mouse_x + x, py = mouse_y + y;
1534:      if (px >= 0 && px < bb_w && py >= 0 && py < bb_h) {
1535:        char p = cursor_bits[y][x];
1536:        if (p == 'X')
1537:          backbuffer[py * bb_w + px] = 0xFFFFFFFF;
1538:        else if (p == '.')
1539:          backbuffer[py * bb_w + px] = 0xFF000000;
1540:      }
1541:    }
1542:  }
1543:
1544:  /* Flush – only upload the damage bounding box */
1545:  if (dev->ops && dev->ops->flush && dev->ops->get_framebuffer) {
1546:    void *fb_va = dev->ops->get_framebuffer(dev, NULL);
1547:    if (fb_va) {
1548:      int dx1 = damage_x1 < 0 ? 0 : damage_x1;
1549:      int dy1 = damage_y1 < 0 ? 0 : damage_y1;
1550:      int dx2 = damage_x2 > bb_w ? bb_w : damage_x2;
1551:      int dy2 = damage_y2 > bb_h ? bb_h : damage_y2;
1552:      if (dx1 < dx2 && dy1 < dy2) {
1553:        int row_bytes = (dx2 - dx1) * 4;
1554:        uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)fb_va;
1555:        const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)backbuffer;
1556:        for (int row = dy1; row < dy2; row++) {
1557:          memcpy(dst + ((size_t)row * bb_w + dx1) * 4,
1558:                 src + ((size_t)row * bb_w + dx1) * 4, row_bytes);
1559:        }
1560:        dev->ops->flush(dev, dx1, dy1, dx2 - dx1, dy2 - dy1);
1561:      }
1562:      damage_x1 = bb_w;
1563:      damage_y1 = bb_h;
1564:      damage_x2 = 0;
1565:      damage_y2 = 0;
1566:    }
1567:  }
1568:
1569:  /* Cleanup regions (guard against early-return paths above) */
1570:  region_destroy(occluded);
1571:  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
1572:    if (visible_regions[i]) {
1573:      region_destroy(visible_regions[i]);
1574:      visible_regions[i] = NULL;
1575:    }
1576:  }
1577:
1578:  __sync_lock_release(&in_render);
1579:}
1580:
1581:/* =========================================================================
1582: * Public render entry points
1583: * ========================================================================= */
1584:void compositor_render(void) {
1585:  uint64_t flags;
1586:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1587:  compositor_render_internal();
1588:  compositor_dirty = 0;
1589:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1590:}
1591:
1592:void compositor_tick(void) {
1593:  uint64_t flags;
1594:  if (spin_trylock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags)) {
1595:    if (compositor_dirty) {
1596:      compositor_dirty = 0;
1597:      compositor_render_internal();
1598:    }
1599:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1600:  }
1601:}
1602:
1603:/* =========================================================================
1604: * Draw to Window
1605: * ========================================================================= */
1606:static void draw_rect_internal(int window_id, int x, int y, int w, int h,
1607:                               uint32_t color, int caller_pid) {
1608:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1609:    if (windows[i].id == window_id && windows[i].buffer) {
1610:      if (windows[i].pid != caller_pid && caller_pid != 1) {
1611:        pr_warn(
1612:            "Compositor: Process %d tried to draw to window %d (owned by %d)\n",
1613:            caller_pid, window_id, windows[i].pid);
1614:        return;
1615:      }
1616:      for (int dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
1617:        for (int dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
1618:          int px = x + dx, py = y + dy;
1619:          if (px >= 0 && px < windows[i].width && py >= 0 &&
1620:              py < windows[i].height && windows[i].buffer)
1621:            windows[i].buffer[py * windows[i].width + px] = color;
1622:        }
1623:      }
1624:      int win_y = windows[i].y + (windows[i].top_most ? 0 : TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT);
1625:      expand_damage(windows[i].x + x, win_y + y, w, h);
1626:      return;
1627:    }
1628:  }
1629:}
1630:
1631:void compositor_draw_rect(int window_id, int x, int y, int w, int h,
1632:                          uint32_t color, int caller_pid) {
1633:  uint64_t flags;
1634:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1635:  draw_rect_internal(window_id, x, y, w, h, color, caller_pid);
1636:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1637:}
1638:
1639:/* =========================================================================
1640: * Blit user buffer to window
1641: * ========================================================================= */
1642:void compositor_blit(int window_id, int x, int y, int w, int h,
1643:                     const uint32_t *user_buf, int caller_pid) {
1644:  uint64_t flags;
1645:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1646:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1647:    if (windows[i].id == window_id && windows[i].buffer) {
1648:      if (windows[i].pid != caller_pid && caller_pid != 1) {
1649:        spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1650:        return;
1651:      }
1652:      for (int dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
1653:        int py = y + dy;
1654:        if (py < 0 || py >= windows[i].height)
1655:          continue;
1656:        int dest_x = x, src_x = 0, copy_w = w;
1657:        if (dest_x < 0) {
1658:          src_x += -dest_x;
1659:          copy_w -= -dest_x;
1660:          dest_x = 0;
1661:        }
1662:        if (dest_x + copy_w > windows[i].width)
1663:          copy_w = windows[i].width - dest_x;
1664:        if (copy_w <= 0)
1665:          continue;
1666:        void *dst_ptr = &windows[i].buffer[py * windows[i].width + dest_x];
1667:        const void *src_ptr = &user_buf[dy * w + src_x];
1668:        if (vmm_copy_from_user(dst_ptr, src_ptr, copy_w * sizeof(uint32_t)) !=
1669:            0) {
1670:          spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1671:          return;
1672:        }
1673:      }
1674:      int win_y = windows[i].y + (windows[i].top_most ? 0 : TITLE_BAR_HEIGHT);
1675:      expand_damage(windows[i].x + x, win_y + y, w, h);
1676:      spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1677:      return;
1678:    }
1679:  }
1680:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1681:}
1682:
1683:void compositor_set_window_flags(int window_id, int flags_val) {
1684:  uint64_t flags;
1685:  spin_lock_irqsave(&compositor_lock, &flags);
1686:  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_WINDOWS; i++) {
1687:    if (windows[i].id == window_id) {
1688:      windows[i].top_most = (flags_val & 1) ? 1 : 0;
1689:      if (flags_val & 4)
1690:        windows[i].visible = 0;
1691:      else if (flags_val & 2)
1692:        windows[i].visible = 1;
1693:      break;
1694:    }
1695:  }
1696:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&compositor_lock, flags);
1697:}

2: * kernel/graphics/draw2d.c

8:/*
9: * Draw Line (Bresenham's Algorithm)
10: */
11:/*
12: * Draw Line (Bresenham's Algorithm)
13: */
14:void graphics_draw_line(uint32_t x0, uint32_t y0, uint32_t x1, uint32_t y1,
15:                        uint32_t color) {
16:  /* Use GL implementation which handles clipping */
17:  struct gl_surface screen;
18:  if (graphics_screen_surface(&screen) == 0) {
19:    struct gl_surface *surf = &screen;
20:    gl_draw_line(surf, (int)x0, (int)y0, (int)x1, (int)y1, color);
21:  }
22:}
23:
24:/*
25: * Draw Circle (Midpoint Algorithm)
26: */
27:void graphics_draw_circle(int cx, int cy, int r, uint32_t color) {
28:  struct gl_surface screen;
29:  if (graphics_screen_surface(&screen) != 0)
30:    return;
31:  struct gl_surface *surf = &screen;
32:
33:  int x = r;
34:  int y = 0;
35:  int err = 0;
36:
37:  while (x >= y) {
38:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx + x, cy + y, color);
39:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx - x, cy + y, color);
40:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx + x, cy - y, color);
41:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx - x, cy - y, color);
42:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx + y, cy + x, color);
43:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx - y, cy + x, color);
44:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx + y, cy - x, color);
45:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, cx - y, cy - x, color);
46:
47:    y++;
48:    err += 1 + 2 * y;
49:    if (2 * (err - x) + 1 > 0) {
50:      x--;
51:      err += 1 - 2 * x;
52:    }
53:  }
54:}
55:
56:/*
57: * Fill Circle
58: */
59:void graphics_fill_circle(int cx, int cy, int r, uint32_t color) {
60:  struct gl_surface screen;
61:  if (graphics_screen_surface(&screen) != 0)
62:    return;
63:  struct gl_surface *surf = &screen;
64:
65:  int x = r;
66:  int y = 0;
67:  int err = 0;
68:
69:  while (x >= y) {
70:    /* Draw horizontal lines for each octant pair with clipping */
71:    for (int i = cx - x; i <= cx + x; i++) {
72:      gl_draw_pixel(surf, i, cy + y, color);
73:      gl_draw_pixel(surf, i, cy - y, color);
74:    }
75:    for (int i = cx - y; i <= cx + y; i++) {
76:      gl_draw_pixel(surf, i, cy + x, color);
77:      gl_draw_pixel(surf, i, cy - x, color);
78:    }
79:
80:    y++;
81:    err += 1 + 2 * y;
82:    if (2 * (err - x) + 1 > 0) {
83:      x--;
84:      err += 1 - 2 * x;
85:    }
86:  }
87:}

89:/*
90: * Draw Triangle Outline
91: */
92:void graphics_draw_triangle(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2,
93:                            uint32_t color) {
94:  graphics_draw_line(x0, y0, x1, y1, color);
95:  graphics_draw_line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color);
96:  graphics_draw_line(x2, y2, x0, y0, color);
97:}

99:/*
100: * Helper: Swap integers
101: */
102:static inline void swap_int(int *a, int *b) {
103:  int t = *a;
104:  *a = *b;
105:  *b = t;
106:}
107:
108:/*
109: * Fill Triangle (Scanline Algorithm)
110: */
111:void graphics_fill_triangle(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2,
112:                            uint32_t color) {
113:  struct gl_surface screen;
114:  if (graphics_screen_surface(&screen) != 0)
115:    return;
116:  struct gl_surface *surf = &screen;
117:
118:  /* Sort by y coordinate */
119:  if (y0 > y1) {
120:    swap_int(&y0, &y1);
121:    swap_int(&x0, &x1);
122:  }
123:  if (y1 > y2) {
124:    swap_int(&y1, &y2);
125:    swap_int(&x1, &x2);
126:  }
127:  if (y0 > y1) {
128:    swap_int(&y0, &y1);
129:    swap_int(&x0, &x1);
130:  }
131:
132:  int total_height = y2 - y0;
133:  if (total_height == 0)
134:    return;
135:
136:  for (int y = y0; y <= y2; y++) {
137:    int second_half = (y > y1) || (y1 == y0);
138:    int segment_height = second_half ? (y2 - y1) : (y1 - y0);
139:    if (segment_height == 0)
140:      continue;
141:
142:    int alpha = (y - y0);
143:    int beta = second_half ? (y - y1) : (y - y0);
144:
145:    int xa = x0 + (x2 - x0) * alpha / total_height;
146:    int xb = second_half ? (x1 + (x2 - x1) * beta / segment_height)
147:                         : (x0 + (x1 - x0) * beta / segment_height);
148:
149:    if (xa > xb)
150:      swap_int(&xa, &xb);
151:
152:    for (int x = xa; x <= xb; x++) {
153:      gl_draw_pixel(surf, x, y, color);
154:    }
155:  }
156:}
157:
158:/*
159: * Draw Rounded Rectangle
160: */
161:void graphics_draw_rounded_rect(int x, int y, int w, int h, int r,
162:                                uint32_t color) {
163:  struct gl_surface screen;
164:  if (graphics_screen_surface(&screen) != 0)
165:    return;
166:  struct gl_surface *surf = &screen;
167:
168:  /* Top and bottom lines */
169:  graphics_draw_line(x + r, y, x + w - r, y, color);
170:  graphics_draw_line(x + r, y + h, x + w - r, y + h, color);
171:
172:  /* Left and right lines */
173:  graphics_draw_line(x, y + r, x, y + h - r, color);
174:  graphics_draw_line(x + w, y + r, x + w, y + h - r, color);
175:
176:  /* Corners (quarter circles using midpoint) */
177:  int px = r, py = 0, err = 0;
178:
179:  while (px >= py) {
180:    /* Top-left */
181:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + r - px, y + r - py, color);
182:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + r - py, y + r - px, color);
183:    /* Top-right */
184:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + w - r + px, y + r - py, color);
185:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + w - r + py, y + r - px, color);
186:    /* Bottom-left */
187:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + r - px, y + h - r + py, color);
188:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + r - py, y + h - r + px, color);
189:    /* Bottom-right */
190:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + w - r + px, y + h - r + py, color);
191:    gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + w - r + py, y + h - r + px, color);
192:
193:    py++;
194:    err += 1 + 2 * py;
195:    if (2 * (err - px) + 1 > 0) {
196:      px--;
197:      err += 1 - 2 * px;
198:    }
199:  }
200:}
201:
202:/*
203: * Alpha Blend Two Colors (ARGB8888)
204: */
205:uint32_t graphics_blend(uint32_t fg, uint32_t bg) {
206:  uint32_t alpha = (fg >> 24) & 0xFF;
207:  if (alpha == 255) return fg;
208:  if (alpha == 0) return bg;
209:
210:  uint32_t inv_alpha = 255 - alpha;
211:  uint32_t r = ((((fg >> 16) & 0xFF) * alpha) + (((bg >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv_alpha)) / 255;
212:  uint32_t g = ((((fg >> 8) & 0xFF) * alpha) + (((bg >> 8) & 0xFF) * inv_alpha)) / 255;
213:  uint32_t b = (((fg & 0xFF) * alpha) + ((bg & 0xFF) * inv_alpha)) / 255;
214:
215:  return 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
216:}
217:
218:/*
219: * Draw Gradient Rectangle (Horizontal)
220: */
221:void graphics_draw_gradient_h(int x, int y, int w, int h, uint32_t color_left,
222:                              uint32_t color_right) {
223:  struct gl_surface screen;
224:  if (graphics_screen_surface(&screen) != 0)
225:    return;
226:  struct gl_surface *surf = &screen;
227:
228:  for (int col = 0; col < w; col++) {
229:    uint32_t t = (col * 255) / (w > 1 ? w - 1 : 1);
230:    uint32_t inv_t = 255 - t;
231:
232:    uint32_t r = ((((color_left >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv_t) + (((color_right >> 16) & 0xFF) * t)) / 255;
233:    uint32_t g = ((((color_left >> 8) & 0xFF) * inv_t) + (((color_right >> 8) & 0xFF) * t)) / 255;
234:    uint32_t b = (((color_left & 0xFF) * inv_t) + ((color_right & 0xFF) * t)) / 255;
235:
236:    uint32_t color = 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
237:
238:    for (int row = 0; row < h; row++) {
239:      gl_draw_pixel(surf, x + col, y + row, color);
240:    }
241:  }
242:}

1:/*
2: * kernel/graphics/draw3d.c
3: * Basic 3D Software Renderer (Integer/Fixed-Point Only)
4: *
5: * Provides simple 3D rendering capabilities:
6: * - Vertex transformation (fixed-point)
7: * - Triangle rasterization with Z-buffer
8: * - Flat shading
9: */
10:#include <kernel/graphics.h>
11:#include <kernel/kmalloc.h>
12:#include <kernel/math.h>
13:#include <kernel/string.h>
14:#include <kernel/types.h>
15:
16:/* Z-Buffer */
17:static int32_t *zbuffer = NULL;
18:static uint32_t zbuffer_width = 0;
19:static uint32_t zbuffer_height = 0;
20:
21:/*
22: * Initialize 3D Renderer
23: */
24:void render3d_init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height) {
25:  /* BUG FIX #1: Memory leak on re-initialization.
26:   * If render3d_init() is called a second time (e.g. on mode change) the old
27:   * zbuffer pointer was silently overwritten, leaking the previous allocation.
28:   * Free it first. */
29:  if (zbuffer) {
30:    kfree(zbuffer);
31:    zbuffer = NULL;
32:  }
33:
34:  zbuffer_width = width;
35:  zbuffer_height = height;
36:
37:  size_t size = width * height * sizeof(int32_t);
38:  zbuffer = (int32_t *)kmalloc(size);
39:  if (zbuffer) {
40:    render3d_clear_zbuffer();
41:  }
42:}
43:
44:/*
45: * Clear Z-Buffer
46: */
47:void render3d_clear_zbuffer(void) {
48:  if (!zbuffer)
49:    return;
50:  int32_t far_z = 0x7FFFFFFF;
51:  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < zbuffer_width * zbuffer_height; i++) {
52:    zbuffer[i] = far_z;
53:  }
54:}
55:
56:/*
57: * Identity Matrix (4x4)
58: * Storage convention throughout this file: m[col][row]  (column-major, OpenGL
59: * style).  mat4_mul_vec confirms this: r.x accumulates m[0..3][0] * v[0..3].
60: */
61:mat4_t mat4_identity(void) {
62:  mat4_t m;
63:  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
64:    for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
65:      m.m[i][j] = (i == j) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
66:  return m;
67:}
68:
69:/*
70: * Translation Matrix
71: * In column-major layout the translation lives in column 3, rows 0-2:
72: * m[3][0..2].  mat4_mul_vec confirms: r.x += m[3][0] * v.w.
73: */
74:mat4_t mat4_translate(float x, float y, float z) {
75:  mat4_t m = mat4_identity();
76:  m.m[3][0] = x;
77:  m.m[3][1] = y;
78:  m.m[3][2] = z;
79:  return m;
80:}
81:
82:/*
83: * Scale Matrix
84: */
85:mat4_t mat4_scale(float x, float y, float z) {
86:  mat4_t m = mat4_identity();
87:  m.m[0][0] = x;
88:  m.m[1][1] = y;
89:  m.m[2][2] = z;
90:  return m;
91:}
92:
93:/*
94: * Rotation Matrix (Y-axis) - integer-trig approximation
95: * angle: float, radians (converted internally to fixed-point for k_sin/cos_fp)
96: *
97: * Standard right-handed Y rotation (column-major, column vectors):
98: *   logical M[row][col] =
99: *     [ cos   0   sin   0 ]
100: *     [  0    1    0    0 ]
101: *     [-sin   0   cos   0 ]
102: *     [  0    0    0    1 ]
103: *
104: * In column-major storage m[col][row] = M[row][col]:
105: *   m[0][0] = cos,  m[2][0] = sin   (column 0)
106: *   m[0][2] = -sin, m[2][2] = cos   (column 2)
107: *
108: * BUG FIX #2: The original code had m[0][2]=+s and m[2][0]=-s, which is
109: * exactly the transpose of the correct rotation — the matrix rotated in the
110: * wrong direction (effectively a negative-angle rotation).
111: */
112:mat4_t mat4_rotate_y(float angle) {
113:  int32_t angle_fp = (int32_t)(angle * FP_ONE);
114:  int32_t c_fp = k_cos_fp(angle_fp);
115:  int32_t s_fp = k_sin_fp(angle_fp);
116:
117:  float c = (float)c_fp / FP_ONE;
118:  float s = (float)s_fp / FP_ONE;
119:
120:  mat4_t m = mat4_identity();
121:  m.m[0][0] = c;  /* M[0][0] */
122:  m.m[2][0] = s;  /* M[0][2]  — was -s (wrong sign) */
123:  m.m[0][2] = -s; /* M[2][0]  — was +s (wrong sign) */
124:  m.m[2][2] = c;  /* M[2][2] */
125:  return m;
126:}
127:
128:/*
129: * Matrix Multiply: C = A * B
130: *
131: * BUG FIX #3 (Critical): The original loop was:
132: *   r.m[i][j] = sum_k  a.m[i][k] * b.m[k][j]
133: *
134: * With column-major storage (m[col][row]), setting col_c=i and row_c=j gives:
135: *   r[col_c][row_c] = sum_k  a[col_c][k] * b[k][row_c]
136: *
137: * But the correct formula for C=A*B in column-major is:
138: *   r[col_c][row_c] = sum_k  a[k][row_c] * b[col_c][k]
139: *
140: * The original formula computes B*A instead of A*B.  For non-commutative
141: * transforms (translate + rotate, MVP assembly, etc.) this produces silently
142: * wrong results.
143: *
144: * Fixed: swap the two index pairs so that a is indexed [k][row] and b is
145: * indexed [col][k].
146: */
147:mat4_t mat4_mul(mat4_t a, mat4_t b) {
148:  mat4_t r;
149:  for (int col = 0; col < 4; col++) {
150:    for (int row = 0; row < 4; row++) {
151:      float sum = 0.0f;
152:      for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
153:        sum += a.m[k][row] * b.m[col][k]; /* was: a.m[col][k] * b.m[k][row] */
154:      }
155:      r.m[col][row] = sum;
156:    }
157:  }
158:  return r;
159:}
160:
161:/*
162: * Transform Vector by Matrix  (v' = M * v)
163: * Consistent with column-major convention: r[row] = sum_col m[col][row]*v[col]
164: */
165:vec4_t mat4_mul_vec(mat4_t m, vec4_t v) {
166:  vec4_t r;
167:  r.x = m.m[0][0] * v.x + m.m[1][0] * v.y + m.m[2][0] * v.z + m.m[3][0] * v.w;
168:  r.y = m.m[0][1] * v.x + m.m[1][1] * v.y + m.m[2][1] * v.z + m.m[3][1] * v.w;
169:  r.z = m.m[0][2] * v.x + m.m[1][2] * v.y + m.m[2][2] * v.z + m.m[3][2] * v.w;
170:  r.w = m.m[0][3] * v.x + m.m[1][3] * v.y + m.m[2][3] * v.z + m.m[3][3] * v.w;
171:  return r;
172:}
173:
174:/*
175: * Perspective Projection Matrix (column-major, OpenGL conventions)
176: *
177: * Note: fov parameter is accepted but the implementation uses a fixed 90° FOV
178: * (tan_half ≈ 0.414 = tan(22.5°)) for simplicity.  A production version
179: * should compute tan_half = tanf(fov * 0.5f).
180: */
181:mat4_t mat4_perspective(float fov, float aspect, float near, float far) {
182:  (void)fov;
183:  mat4_t m = {{{0}}};
184:
185:  float tan_half = 0.414f; /* tan(45°/2) ≈ tan(22.5°) — fixed 90° HFOV */
186:
187:  m.m[0][0] = 1.0f / (aspect * tan_half);
188:  m.m[1][1] = 1.0f / tan_half;
189:  m.m[2][2] = -(far + near) / (far - near);
190:  m.m[2][3] = -1.0f;
191:  m.m[3][2] = -(2.0f * far * near) / (far - near);
192:
193:  return m;
194:}
195:
196:/*
197: * Project clip-space vertex to integer screen coordinates.
198: *
199: * BUG FIX #4a: Unsafe float comparison `v.w != 0`.
200: * IEEE 754 equality on floats is unreliable and may warn with -Wfloat-equal.
201: * Use an epsilon guard instead.
202: *
203: * BUG FIX #4b: Potential int32_t overflow in sz.
204: * After perspective divide, nz is nominally in [-1, 1], but floating-point
205: * arithmetic can push it slightly outside that range.  Multiplying an nz of,
206: * say, 1.0000001 by 0x7FFFFFFF produces a value that overflows int32_t.
207: * Clamp nz to [-1, 1] before the conversion.
208: */
209:static void project_to_screen(vec4_t v, int *sx, int *sy, int32_t *sz,
210:                              int screen_w, int screen_h) {
211:  /* BUG FIX #4a: epsilon guard instead of != 0 */
212:  float inv_w = (v.w > 1e-6f || v.w < -1e-6f) ? (1.0f / v.w) : 1.0f;
213:
214:  float nx = v.x * inv_w;
215:  float ny = v.y * inv_w;
216:  float nz = v.z * inv_w;
217:
218:  /* BUG FIX #4b: clamp nz to prevent overflow when casting to int32_t */
219:  if (nz > 1.0f)
220:    nz = 1.0f;
221:  if (nz < -1.0f)
222:    nz = -1.0f;
223:
224:  *sx = (int)((nx + 1.0f) * 0.5f * screen_w);
225:  *sy = (int)((1.0f - ny) * 0.5f * screen_h);
226:  *sz = (int32_t)((nz + 1.0f) * 0.5f * (float)0x7FFFFFFF);
227:}
228:
229:/*
230: * Draw 3D Triangle — Wireframe with Z-buffer support
231: *
232: * BUG FIX #5: The original code computed sz0/sz1/sz2 but never used them —
233: * the zbuffer array was allocated and cleared but never read or written during
234: * actual rendering.  For a pure wireframe path the per-line Z-test is non-
235: * trivial (requires per-pixel interpolation); the values are retained here so
236: * a future filled-triangle path can use them.  The wireframe lines are still
237: * drawn unconditionally, but the sz values are now at least preserved for
238: * callers that may build on this function.  A TODO marks the missing zbuffer
239: * integration for future filled rasterization.
240: */
241:void render3d_triangle(vec4_t v0, vec4_t v1, vec4_t v2, mat4_t mvp,
242:                       uint32_t color, int screen_w, int screen_h) {
243:  struct gl_surface screen;
244:  if (graphics_screen_surface(&screen) != 0)
245:    return;
246:  struct gl_surface *surf = &screen;
247:
248:  /* Transform vertices */
249:  vec4_t t0 = mat4_mul_vec(mvp, v0);
250:  vec4_t t1 = mat4_mul_vec(mvp, v1);
251:  vec4_t t2 = mat4_mul_vec(mvp, v2);
252:
253:  /* Project to screen */
254:  int sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1, sx2, sy2;
255:  int32_t sz0, sz1, sz2;
256:  project_to_screen(t0, &sx0, &sy0, &sz0, screen_w, screen_h);
257:  project_to_screen(t1, &sx1, &sy1, &sz1, screen_w, screen_h);
258:  project_to_screen(t2, &sx2, &sy2, &sz2, screen_w, screen_h);
259:
260:  /* Simple back-face / behind-camera cull: skip if all verts have w <= 0 */
261:  if (t0.w <= 0.0f && t1.w <= 0.0f && t2.w <= 0.0f)
262:    return;
263:
264:  /*
265:   * TODO: zbuffer integration for filled rasterization.
266:   * sz0/sz1/sz2 are computed above and zbuffer[] is ready; a scanline fill
267:   * loop should interpolate sz per-pixel and test/update zbuffer[y*w+x].
268:   * Wireframe edges do not perform per-pixel Z testing.
269:   */
270:  (void)sz0;
271:  (void)sz1;
272:  (void)sz2;
273:
274:  /* Draw wireframe */
275:  gl_draw_line(surf, sx0, sy0, sx1, sy1, color);
276:  gl_draw_line(surf, sx1, sy1, sx2, sy2, color);
277:  gl_draw_line(surf, sx2, sy2, sx0, sy0, color);
278:}
279:
280:/*
281: * Draw Simple 3D Cube (Wireframe)
282: */
283:void render3d_cube(float x, float y, float z, float size, mat4_t view_proj,
284:                   uint32_t color, int screen_w, int screen_h) {
285:  float s = size / 2.0f;
286:
287:  /* 8 vertices */
288:  vec4_t verts[8] = {
289:      {x - s, y - s, z - s, 1}, {x + s, y - s, z - s, 1},
290:      {x + s, y + s, z - s, 1}, {x - s, y + s, z - s, 1},
291:      {x - s, y - s, z + s, 1}, {x + s, y - s, z + s, 1},
292:      {x + s, y + s, z + s, 1}, {x - s, y + s, z + s, 1},
293:  };
294:
295:  /* 12 triangles (2 per face) */
296:  int indices[12][3] = {
297:      {0, 1, 2}, {0, 2, 3}, /* Front  (-Z) */
298:      {4, 6, 5}, {4, 7, 6}, /* Back   (+Z) */
299:      {0, 5, 1}, {0, 4, 5}, /* Bottom (-Y) */
300:      {2, 7, 3}, {2, 6, 7}, /* Top    (+Y) */
301:      {0, 7, 4}, {0, 3, 7}, /* Left   (-X) */
302:      {1, 5, 6}, {1, 6, 2}, /* Right  (+X) */
303:  };
304:
305:  for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
306:    render3d_triangle(verts[indices[i][0]], verts[indices[i][1]],
307:                      verts[indices[i][2]], view_proj, color, screen_w,
308:                      screen_h);
309:  }
310:}

@@@ kernel/graphics/font.c @@@
1:/*
2: * kernel/graphics/font.c
3: * Font rendering and management
4: *
5: * Role:
6: *   Per-glyph alpha-masked blit from a pre-rasterised bitmap font embedded
7: *   via <graphics/default_font.h> (Rewir-Light.ttf, compiled to a C array).
8: *   Provides gl_draw_char / gl_draw_string for use by compositor.c's terminal
9: *   emulator, and exports font metric queries (height, ascent, max width).
10: *   Also implements sys_set_font(), the syscall entry point (syscall 253) that
11: *   allows userland to replace the active font at runtime.
12: *
13: * Font state:
14: *   The singleton current_font struct holds a font_header (magic, first_char,
15: *   num_chars, ascent, descent, bitmap_size), a pointer to the glyph-info
16: *   array (glyphs), a pointer to the bitmap data, and an is_dynamic flag.
17: *   At startup, glyphs and bitmap point into the statically-linked default
18: *   font arrays.  After sys_set_font(), they point into user-space memory.
19: *
20: * Rendering:
21: *   gl_draw_char locates the glyph_info for a codepoint, reads the per-pixel
22: *   alpha mask from the bitmap, and blends each non-zero pixel onto the
23: *   surface using an >>8 approximation (not exact /255 division).  Fully
24: *   opaque pixels (alpha=255) are written directly.
25: *
26: * Locking & IRQ context:
27: *   No lock protects current_font.  gl_draw_char is called from
28: *   compositor_window_write (under compositor_lock) and from
29: *   compositor_render_internal (also under compositor_lock from
30: *   compositor_tick, which fires from a timer IRQ).  sys_set_font is called
31: *   from syscall context.  There is no synchronisation between them.
32: *
33: * Known issues:
34: *   GFX-FONT-01 (W4 SECURITY BUG, FIXED) sys_set_font no longer stores the raw
35: *               userland pointer: it copies the whole blob into a kmalloc'd
36: *               kernel buffer, validates it against the kernel copy (magic,
37: *               metrics, per-glyph bitmap bounds), and publishes an immutable
38: *               descriptor behind font_lock, retiring the previous one.  This
39: *               removes the dangling-pointer use-after-free (process exit after
40: *               set-font), the kernel-memory info-leak (a kernel VA passed as
41: *               'data'), and the size-overflow path (num_chars is uint16 and
42: *               bitmap_size uint32, with the blob bounded by FONT_MAX_BLOB).
43: *   GFX-FONT-02 (W3 BUG, FIXED) graphics_font_height() floors to the built-in
44: *               default height when ascent+descent <= 0, so a malformed font
45: *               (ascent=descent=0 via sys_set_font) can no longer divide-by-zero
46: *               in compositor_create_window (h / char_h, compositor.c:204).
47: */
48:#include <graphics/gl.h>
49:#include <kernel/graphics.h>
50:#include <kernel/types.h>
51:#include <kernel/arch.h>      /* arch_copy_from_user (GFX-FONT-01) */
52:#include <kernel/kmalloc.h>   /* kmalloc/kfree (GFX-FONT-01) */
53:#include <kernel/spinlock.h>  /* font_lock (GFX-FONT-01) */
54:#include <font.h>
55:#include <drivers/gpu/gpu.h>
56:
57:/* Include the pre-rasterized Rewir-Light.ttf */
58:#include <graphics/default_font.h>
59:
60:/* Forward declarations */
61:/* utf8_decode: defined in kernel/lib/utf8.c (or equivalent); advances 's' by
62: * the byte width of the first codepoint and writes the decoded value to *code.
63: * Returns byte count consumed (1..4), or <= 0 on invalid sequence. */
64:int utf8_decode(const char *s, size_t len, uint32_t *code);
65:
66:/* Internal font state */
67:/* GFX-FONT-01: the active font is an immutable descriptor published behind
68: * font_lock as current_font.  sys_set_font builds a new descriptor in a single
69: * kmalloc block, swaps the pointer under the lock, and retires the previous
70: * block; readers hold font_lock while they touch the descriptor, so a retired
71: * buffer is never freed under a live reader.  heap_base is the kmalloc block to
72: * free on retire (NULL for the static built-in default, which is never freed). */
73:struct font_state {
74:    struct font_header header;
75:    const struct font_glyph_info *glyphs;
76:    const uint8_t *bitmap;
77:    void *heap_base;
78:};
79:
80:static struct font_state default_font = {
81:    .header = {
82:        .magic = FONT_MAGIC,
83:        .first_char = FONT_FIRST_CHAR,
84:        .num_chars = FONT_NUM_CHARS,
85:        .ascent = FONT_ASCENT,
86:        .descent = FONT_DESCENT,
87:        .bitmap_size = 0
88:    },
89:    .glyphs = font_glyphs,
90:    .bitmap = font_bitmap,
91:    .heap_base = 0
92:};
93:
94:static struct font_state *current_font = &default_font;
95:static DEFINE_SPINLOCK(font_lock);
96:
97:#define FONT_MAX_BLOB (8u * 1024 * 1024)  /* upper bound on a user font blob */
98:
99:/*
100: * gl_draw_char - render one Unicode codepoint from the active font onto surf.
101: *
102: * Params: surf — target surface; x, y — top-left origin for the glyph cell;
103: *         codepoint — Unicode scalar value; color — ARGB8888 foreground.
104: *
105: * Algorithm:
106: *   1. Compute glyph index: idx = codepoint - first_char.  Out-of-range
107: *      codepoints (idx < 0 or >= num_chars) are silently skipped.
108: *   2. Look up font_glyph_info gi from current_font.glyphs[idx].
109: *   3. Compute pixel origin: start_x = x + gi->x0,
110: *      start_y = y + ascent + gi->y0  (baseline offset).
111: *   4. Walk the glyph's alpha mask (gi->height rows x gi->width cols):
112: *      - alpha==0: skip (transparent pixel).
113: *      - alpha==255: direct write (no blend arithmetic).
114: *      - otherwise: blend using >>8 approximation (not exact /255).
115: *        Note: >>8 differs from /255 by at most 1 LSB; visible only at
116: *        specific alpha values (e.g. alpha=128, dst=255 → 127 vs 128).
117: *   5. Per-pixel bounds check against surf->width/height before any write.
118: *
119: * GFX-FONT-01 (fixed): current_font.glyphs/bitmap now reference a kmalloc'd
120: *   kernel descriptor (never userland memory).
121: *
122: * Locking: takes font_lock across the blit so a concurrent sys_set_font cannot
123: *          retire/free the descriptor mid-read; also called under compositor_lock
124: *          from compositor_window_write and compositor_render_internal
125: *          (lock order: compositor_lock -> font_lock).
126: * Side effects: writes pixels to surf->buffer.
127: */
128:/*
129: * Draw character using GL
130: */
131:/* gl_draw_char_clipped - blit one glyph, writing only pixels inside the clip
132: * box [cx1,cx2) x [cy1,cy2).  gl_draw_char passes the full surface as the clip
133: * box; the compositor passes the per-frame damage box (GFX-COMP-03 damage clip)
134: * so title text never paints outside the changed region. */
135:static void gl_draw_char_clipped(struct gl_surface *surf, int x, int y,
136:                                 uint32_t codepoint, uint32_t color, int cx1,
137:                                 int cy1, int cx2, int cy2) {
138:  if (!surf)
139:    return;
140:
141:  /* Intersect the requested clip box with the surface bounds. */
142:  if (cx1 < 0)
143:    cx1 = 0;
144:  if (cy1 < 0)
145:    cy1 = 0;
146:  if (cx2 > (int)surf->width)
147:    cx2 = (int)surf->width;
148:  if (cy2 > (int)surf->height)
149:    cy2 = (int)surf->height;
150:  if (cx1 >= cx2 || cy1 >= cy2)
151:    return;
152:
153:  /* GFX-FONT-01: hold font_lock across the whole blit so a concurrent
154:   * sys_set_font cannot free the descriptor's bitmap while we read it. */
155:  uint64_t flags;
156:  spin_lock_irqsave(&font_lock, &flags);
157:  const struct font_state *f = current_font;
158:
159:  if (!f->bitmap) {
160:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&font_lock, flags);
161:    return;
162:  }
163:
164:  int idx = (int)codepoint - f->header.first_char;
165:  if (idx < 0 || idx >= f->header.num_chars) {
166:    spin_unlock_irqrestore(&font_lock, flags);
167:    return;
168:  }
169:
170:  const struct font_glyph_info *gi = &f->glyphs[idx];
171:  const uint8_t *bitmap = f->bitmap + gi->data_offset;
172:
173:  int start_x = x + gi->x0;
174:  int start_y = y + f->header.ascent + gi->y0;
175:
176:  uint32_t r_color = (color >> 16) & 0xFF;
177:  uint32_t g_color = (color >> 8) & 0xFF;
178:  uint32_t b_color = color & 0xFF;
179:
180:  for (int gy = 0; gy < gi->height; gy++) {
181:    for (int gx = 0; gx < gi->width; gx++) {
182:      uint8_t alpha = bitmap[gy * gi->width + gx];
183:      if (alpha == 0)
184:        continue;
185:
186:      int px = start_x + gx;
187:      int py = start_y + gy;
188:
189:      if (px >= cx1 && px < cx2 && py >= cy1 && py < cy2) {
190:        if (alpha == 255) {
191:          surf->buffer[py * surf->stride + px] = color;
192:          continue;
193:        }
194:
195:        /* Proper coverage blend: round-to-nearest /255 (not >>8), so anti-
196:         * aliased glyph edges are full-strength, not dimmed (GFX-DYN-01 #121.4). */
197:        uint32_t bg = surf->buffer[py * surf->stride + px];
198:        uint32_t inv_alpha = 255 - alpha;
199:
200:        uint32_t r = gl_div255(r_color * alpha + ((bg >> 16) & 0xFF) * inv_alpha);
201:        uint32_t gr = gl_div255(g_color * alpha + ((bg >> 8) & 0xFF) * inv_alpha);
202:        uint32_t b = gl_div255(b_color * alpha + (bg & 0xFF) * inv_alpha);
203:
204:        surf->buffer[py * surf->stride + px] = 0xFF000000 | (r << 16) | (gr << 8) | b;
205:      }
206:    }
207:  }
208:  spin_unlock_irqrestore(&font_lock, flags);
209:}
210:
211:void gl_draw_char(struct gl_surface *surf, int x, int y, uint32_t codepoint,
212:                  uint32_t color) {
213:  if (!surf)
214:    return;
215:  gl_draw_char_clipped(surf, x, y, codepoint, color, 0, 0, (int)surf->width,
216:                       (int)surf->height);
217:}
